ambiguity: 'Kharab' is not defined (affliction by whom or by which house).
classical_check: Partly differs: classically a retrograde Jupiter has extra strength (cheshta bala), so linking retrograde to bad speech is his own.

hindi: शुक्र में कुटिलता है, समझदारी है और पूरे के पूरे सिस्टम के विपरीत जाकर के सब परिवर्तन करने की ताकत है। यह वो कर सकता है।
says: Venus carries cunning and shrewdness and has the power to go against the whole system and bring about full change; he sees Venus as the revolutionary, system-breaking planet.
classical_check: Differs: classically the revolution or system-breaking role belongs more to Rahu or Saturn; Venus is the planet of harmony, so this is his own view.

hindi: और यह है ज्ञानी। यह ज्ञानी है। विद्वान नहीं कहेंगे। विद्वान पढ़ा लिखा होता है वो बुध हो सकता है और ग्रह हो सकते हैं।
says: Venus is a gyani (a wise, realised person), not a vidvan (a learned scholar); the book-learned scholar can be Mercury or other planets, while Venus is wisdom.
classical_check: Silent on this distinction; Mercury is the classical karaka of learning, which agrees on that side.

hindi: इसके पास नॉलेज के साथ विज़डम है। डायरेक्शन उल्टा है।
says: Venus has knowledge together with wisdom, and its direction is reversed, so it applies knowledge in an unconventional way.
ambiguity: 'Direction' goes back to the reverse rotation analogy.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो जब भी आप समाज में नॉर्मल समाज के तरीके से चलने से पलट के कुछ करते हो वो शुक्र है।
says: Whenever you turn around and act against the normal way of society, that is Venus working in you, so unconventional action is a Venus signature.
classical_check: Differs from the classical view; unconventional action is usually Rahu, Uranus or Saturn territory.

hindi: और दुनिया आपको कहती है अरे गलत है। सही नहीं कर रहा बर्बाद हो जाएगा लेकिन आप रॉकेट बन जाते हैं। यह शुक्र ग्रह की कृपा है।
says: The world says you are wrong and will be ruined, yet you shoot up like a rocket, and that unexpected success is Venus's grace.
ambiguity: No chart condition for when this success happens.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसी शुक्र ग्रह के पास आपकी धन है, दौलत है, कैश है, मकान, गाड़ी, व बंगला, वैभव, सौंदर्य,
says: Venus holds your money, wealth, cash, house, car, bungalow, splendour and beauty, so these are the material and luxury significations of Venus.
ambiguity: List continues into the next block.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is the classical karaka of wealth, vehicles, houses and luxury.

hindi: आपके चेहरे पे चमक है। आपके पर्सनालिटी में गजब का आकर्षण है। खिंचाव है। यह शुक्र है।
says: The radiance on your face and the strong magnetism in your personality also belong to Venus, completing the list of its signified qualities.
ambiguity: The first word 'ojh' (lustre) is half cut off by the caption break.
classical_check: Agrees with Venus as karaka of charm and facial lustre.

hindi: शुक्र ग्रह आदेश देता है। बृहस्पति उपदेश देता है। वो कहता है कि देखो ऐसे करना चाहिए। शुक्र कहता है टांग तोड़ दूंगा अगर यह नहीं किया तो।
says: Venus commands while Jupiter only advises: Jupiter says 'you should do it this way', Venus says 'I will break your leg if you do not', so Venus is the forceful, enforcing planet.
ambiguity: The threat is rhetorical, not a literal prediction.
classical_check: Differs: classically Jupiter is the guru and Venus the diplomat, but Venus as 'commander' is his own scheme.

hindi: अगर शुक्र जैसा गुरु होगा तो पैर में बेड़िया डाल के भी चेला बना देगा। बृहस्पति जैसा गुरु होगा मैंने तुम्हें बता दिया करना करो ना करो।
says: A teacher of Venus type will chain your feet if needed to make you a disciple, while a Jupiter-type guru only tells you the way and leaves it to you to act or not.
classical_check: Silent; both Jupiter (Brihaspati) and Venus (Shukracharya) are gurus in tradition, with the contrast here being his own.

hindi: बृहस्पति के कहता है मेरे पीछे पीछे आना आ जाना तब दूंगा कुछ सिखा दूंगा। उसका विचित्र अहंकार है भाई।
says: The Jupiter-type teacher says follow me behind and then I will teach you something, a curious kind of ego, in which the disciple has to come to him first.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter's ego or pride is not a classical trait, where Jupiter is humble-wise.

hindi: और शुक्र कहता है साले तू आगे क्या? मैं तेरे घसीट के ले चलूंगा। तू आगे जा मैं देख तेरे पीछा करके तेरे को कूट कूट के सेट करूंगा।
says: Venus says you go ahead and I will chase you from behind and beat you into shape; Venus pushes from behind and drags the person through, in contrast to Jupiter's lead-and-follow.
ambiguity: The scene is a joke, but the pushing from behind is the point.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए स्त्री का बड़ा सुंदर गुण होता है। जिस लड़के से उसे प्रेम हो गया उसको वो देखती है और कहती है चल मेरे पीछे पीछे आजा।
says: A woman in love with a boy tells him to follow behind her, so Venus in love takes the lead, which is the opposite direction of the pushing-from-behind image just used.
ambiguity: This seems to contradict the preceding 'I will chase you from behind' image; he may mean love makes Venus lead and hate makes her check.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जिससे उसे नफरत होती है वो उसे चेक करती रहती है। क्या पीछे पीछे अभी आ रहा है कि नहीं आ रहा? वो छोड़ती नहीं।
says: Toward the one she hates she keeps checking whether he is still following behind and never lets go, showing Venus's tenacity in both love and hate.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसीलिए शुक्र ग्रह का मतलब जहां कुंडली में शुक्र बैठा है आप
says: The Venus-trait of holding on and chasing applies in the area where Venus sits in the kundli, so that house is where you do not let go; the sentence is cut off after 'you'.
cells_derived_method: Where Venus sits decides which life area gets the tenacity; the sign adds the manner.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in own sign Libra in the 2nd house (lagna Virgo): clinging to money, family and speech, holding on to what is possessed.
Derived: Venus in Gemini in the 5th house (lagna Aquarius): persistent about romance, children and learning, with a talkative style.
Derived: Venus in Scorpio in the 8th house (lagna Aries): intense, secret tenacity about hidden matters and shared resources.

ambiguity: Caption cuts the sentence, so the exact claim is guessed from the earlier sentence.
classical_check: Consistent with house-based readings, not a stated classical rule about tenacity.

hindi: उसे छोड़ोगे नहीं। भले ही आप पुरुष हो या स्त्री हो उससे लेनदेन नहीं है। आप उस चीज को छोड़ना नहीं चाहोगे।
says: Whatever area Venus points to in your chart, you will not let go of it, whether you are a man or a woman; gender makes no difference to this attachment.
cells_derived_method: The area you will not give up is the topic of the house Venus sits in; the sign changes how the clinging shows and whether it is easy or fraught.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in Sagittarius in the 11th house (lagna Aquarius): will not give up friends' circle, gains and wish-fulfilment, held with a philosophical, travel-loving flavour.
Derived: Venus in Leo in the 9th house (lagna Sagittarius): clings to status in belief, teachers and fortune, with pride in the way it is held.
Derived: Venus exalted in Pisces in the 6th house (lagna Libra): stays attached to routines, service and even conflict situations, handling them gracefully.

ambiguity: Continues the cut-off sentence from the previous block, so 'it' means the thing shown by Venus's seat.
classical_check: Consistent with house-based reading, not a stated classical rule about not letting go.

hindi: जीवन में हम शब्द कहते हैं। अरे सब मोह माया है। ये बृहस्पति महाराज आ गए।
says: The talk 'it is all moha-maya, an illusion' is Jupiter speaking; Jupiter is the philosopher planet that renounces and dismisses worldly attachment.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the karaka of philosophy and detachment, though Ketu and Saturn are the stronger renunciation planets.

hindi: और कई लोग फिर कहते हैं रखा तो कुछ नहीं लेकिन भाई मजा बड़ा आता है। यह शुक्र है।
says: When people admit there is nothing in worldly life yet say it is great fun, that enjoyment is Venus; Venus is the pleasure that keeps us attached despite Jupiter's philosophy.
classical_check: Agrees with Venus as the karaka of pleasure and enjoyment.

hindi: पर क्या आप उस मजे को परफॉर्म कर रहे हैं? यह इंद्र है।
says: Whether you actually perform and express that enjoyment is Indra, meaning Uranus; Uranus is the planet of performance and active expression of Venus's pleasure.
ambiguity: 'Perform' could mean display or putting into action; he does not pin it down.
classical_check: Uranus is outside classical Jyotish, so no classical view; Indra as Uranus is his own scheme.

hindi: क्या आप उस परफॉर्मेंस को सबके साथ कर रहे हैं? यह वरुण है। नेप्च्यून
says: Whether you carry out that performance together with everyone, sharing it widely, is Varuna, which he equates with Neptune; Neptune is the collective, universal side of Venus's enjoyment.
ambiguity: 'With everyone' may mean public or shared or universal.
classical_check: Neptune is not classical; Varuna as Neptune is his own mapping of the 12 planets.

hindi: आपके जीवन के अंदर आप किस प्रकार से कार्य कर रहे हैं, उस प्रकार से आपका शुक्र पावर पकड़ेगा।
says: The power Venus gains in your life depends on how you act in life, through the Indra and Varuna steps, so Venus strengthens through expression and sharing, not just by existing.
ambiguity: Not defined as a measurable condition in a chart.
classical_check: Silent; classical Venus strength comes from sign, house and aspect, not behaviour.

hindi: हमारे शरीर में यह हमारा थर्ड आई है जहां चंद्रमा बैठ गया। यह हमारा बुध बैठ गया गले पर। हमारे हृदय के ऊपर शुक्र महाराज बैठ गए। यह राशियों की प्लेसमेंट है।
says: He maps planets onto body portals: the Moon sits at the third eye, Mercury at the throat and Venus over the heart, and calls this the placement of the signs on the body.
cells_derived_method: The sign that is rising in the first house starts the body-portal sequence, so each sign's portal decides which body area the first house stands for; see his later signs 2 and 7 for heart.
ambiguity: Which signs belong to each portal is only given in later sentences, and the third eye placement is not tied to a sign here.
classical_check: Differs from the classical Kalapurusha body map (Aries head, Taurus face and throat, Gemini arms, Cancer chest, Leo heart); his map is his own scheme.

says: He gives the sign numbering in order, 1 Aries, 2 Taurus and so on, confirming the standard Aries-first numbering for signs.
ambiguity: List is split across the block break; the rest follows in the next timestamp.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard zodiac order.

hindi: मिथुन, कर्क, सिंह, कन्या, तुला एंड सो ऑन। जो राशियां हमारे शरीर में कोस्पोंड करती हैं।
says: Completing the sign list (Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra and on), he adds that each of these signs corresponds to a part or portal of the human body.
ambiguity: The exact body part per sign is not given in this sentence.
classical_check: Agrees in principle with Kalapurusha (the zodiac laid over the body), though his body parts differ.

gist: Says that whenever we look at a kundli we see this kind of drawn framework.

hindi: इस खाके के अंदर एक खासियत है कि ये ऐसा ही होता है। ये पहला ही घर होता है यहां। ये सप्तम, चतुर्थ, चौथा, दसवा ऐसे ऐसे चल रहे हैं।
says: In this chart frame the positions of the houses are fixed: the first house always sits in the same place and the 7th, 4th and 10th fall opposite or at right angles to it, the same in every chart.
ambiguity: He is pointing at a diagram; which layout (north or south Indian) is not stated, and the wording 'fourth, chautha' is a repeat.
classical_check: Agrees with the fixed house positions of the North Indian chart where houses 1, 4, 7, 10 are kendras.

hindi: ये क्लॉकवाइज है। ये एंटीक्लॉकवाइज। ये दूसरा है। ये चलता है। क्योंकि धरती ऐसे चलती है। ये ऐसे उल्टा चल।
says: He contrasts a clockwise direction with an anticlockwise one and says the houses are counted in the anticlockwise direction, the way the Earth turns, while something else runs the reverse; this is a direction note on the diagram.
ambiguity: Garbled: he is gesturing at the diagram, and which things run clockwise or anticlockwise is not recoverable from the words.
classical_check: Houses in the North Indian chart are counted anticlockwise, which is consistent with this reading if so.

hindi: अब यहां पर आप हो सकता है अपनी-अपनी कुंडलियों में राशि यानी नंबर अलग देखेंगे। हो सकता है यहां आप चार नंबर देख लें, तीन देखें, आठ देखें। ये राशि है।
says: The house positions are fixed, but the sign number written in a house differs from chart to chart; the first house may carry sign 4, 3 or 8 depending on the person, so house and sign are two separate things.
cells_derived_method: The same house reads differently depending on the sign number it carries: house topic stays, sign nature changes the style, which is the 12 x 12 grid logic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: sign 4 (Cancer) in the first house gives a Moon-ruled, emotional and nurturing self-image.
Derived: sign 3 (Gemini) in the first house gives a Mercury-ruled, talkative and curious self-image.
Derived: sign 8 (Scorpio) in the first house gives a Mars-ruled, intense and secretive self-image.

ambiguity: The numbers 4, 3, 8 are used as examples in the first house only; he points at the first house, inferred from the context of the previous sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: the lagna sign varies by person and house numbers stay fixed.

hindi: यानी आपके शरीर में जो पोर्टल है ना वहां से ऑन हो रहा है।
says: The sign in the rising position switches on, in your body, the portal that corresponds to that sign, so the lagna sign is the body entry point from which life starts.
cells_derived_method: Each rising sign opens a different body portal, so the first house is read through that portal.
ambiguity: 'Portal' is his word for a body zone, and the sentence does not say which zone goes with which sign.
classical_check: Resembles the classical idea that the lagna represents the body (tanu), but the portal wording is his own.

hindi: तो आप क्या हो? ये आप हो। ये आपका साथी यानी पत्नी है।
says: The first house is you, and the opposite house is your partner or wife.
ambiguity: He is pointing at the diagram without saying house numbers, so 1 and 7 are inferred from the standard layout.
classical_check: Agrees: 1st house is self and 7th is the spouse.

hindi: ये आपकी मम्मी है। ये पापा है।
says: The next two houses on the diagram stand for your mother and your father.
ambiguity: Pointing only; 4th for mother and 10th for father are inferred from the layout and from the order in which he walks the kendras.
classical_check: Mother as 4th agrees; father as 10th differs from the common Parashari 9th but is used by some schools.

hindi: ये काम है।
says: One of the houses on the diagram stands for work or desire (kaam), left unspecified.
ambiguity: 'Kaam' can mean work or karma (10th) or desire (7th or 3rd); the house is not named, so no cell is claimed.
classical_check: Silent as unspecified; kama is classically the 3rd, 7th and 11th, and karma the 10th.

hindi: ये शत्रु है। ये मृत्यु है।
says: Two further houses stand for enemies and for death, the dusthana houses on the diagram.
ambiguity: Pointing only; 6th and 8th are inferred from the standard layout and the order he walks.
classical_check: Agrees: 6th is enemies and 8th is death and longevity.

hindi: ये भाई ताऊ चाचे
says: One house stands for brothers, paternal uncles of the elder and younger kind, meaning the wider male kin of the same generation or one above.
ambiguity: House not named: could be the 3rd (siblings) or the 11th (elder siblings); he later says the 3rd is courage and siblings, which makes 11th possible here.
classical_check: Siblings are classically the 3rd (younger) and 11th (elder).

hindi: ये आपका मोक्ष का द्वार है।
says: The twelfth house is the gate of moksha, liberation.
ambiguity: The house number is inferred: expenses, water and hospital follow in the next sentence, which are 12th-house topics.
classical_check: Agrees: the 12th house is moksha and loss.

hindi: खर्चा है। पानी है। हॉस्पिटल है।
says: The same house also covers expenses, water and hospital, meaning losses, hospitalisation and the liquid element.
ambiguity: Continues from 'gate of moksha', so 12th is inferred; 'water' is not a standard 12th topic and may refer to his water-chakra scheme.
classical_check: Expenses and hospitals are classical 12th topics; water is not a standard 12th significator.

hindi: ये आपके धन की स्थिति ये आपका पराक्रम हो गया। वैभव हो गया, भाई, बहन।
says: One house shows the state of your wealth and another your courage and effort, also splendour, brothers and sisters, so the 2nd covers money and the 3rd covers valour and siblings.
ambiguity: Houses are pointed at, so 2nd and 3rd are inferred; 'vaibhav' (splendour) could belong to either or to the 11th.
classical_check: Agrees: 2nd wealth, 3rd courage (parakrama) and siblings.

hindi: यहां से आपकी संतान इत्यादि संतान को आप संतान समझे और आपने अपने जन्म में आने के बाद क्या पैदा किया? दो मकान बनाए तो इसकी कृपा से बनाए, मकान यहां आए। कॉम्बिनेशन देखना पड़ता है।
says: The 5th house shows children, and broadly everything you create after being born, so two houses you built come by this house's grace too, though the combination with the 4th house must be checked.
ambiguity: 5th for children is inferred from the diagram; the house-building claim links to the 4th and he says 'combination must be seen' without naming it.
classical_check: 5th as children agrees; 'creations' as 5th is an extension (classically purva-punya and creativity); houses/property are the 4th.

hindi: तो राशियां घूमती है। तो यहां पर राशि जो स्टार्टिंग की है वो आपकी कहां चली? कहां से आई? वो आपके शरीर के उस पोर्टल से आए जिस पोर्टल से हमने यहां पर हम स्टार्टिंग कर रहे हैं।
says: The signs rotate through the houses, so the starting sign in your first house comes from the body portal that matches it; the portal where your lagna sign sits is where your chart begins.
ambiguity: Words are a loose, spoken restatement of the portal idea; the exact portal per sign is not given here.
classical_check: Silent; portal wording is his own.

hindi: आठ नंबर लग्न में बैठा तो यह आपका प्रथम पोर्टल है। 11 नंबर बैठा तो प्रथम पोर्टल आपका ये है। प्रथम प्रथम ही है।
says: If sign 8 is rising, that body zone is your first portal; if sign 11 is rising, a different zone is your first portal; but the first house stays first in both cases.
cells_derived_method: The first house always stands for you, but the rising sign decides which body zone and temperament the first house expresses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio rising (sign 8), a Mars-ruled water sign, makes the lower body (fire and water chakra area in his scheme) the starting portal.
Derived: Aquarius rising (sign 11), a Saturn-ruled air sign, makes a different, lower-limb or circulation zone the starting portal in classical Kalapurusha; his own body zone is not stated.

ambiguity: He points at body zones without naming them, so which zone each sign is cannot be read from the caption.
classical_check: Classical Kalapurusha puts Scorpio at the genitals and Aquarius at the calves and ankles, so the derived zones follow that, not him.

hindi: वहां पर राशि बदल गई। मींस आपका उस ग्रह का घर ये राशि नंबर क्या होता है? यह घर होते हैं।
says: When the sign in a house changes, it means a different planet's home occupies it; a sign number simply tells you whose home that is, so signs are planets' homes.
classical_check: Agrees: each sign is the home (rashi svami) of a lord.

hindi: एक नंबर मंगल का घर है। मंगल कह रहा है भैया मेरा घर है। कहीं भी है मंगल के बाहर प्लेट लगी हुई है।
says: Sign 1, Aries, is Mars's home, with Mars's nameplate outside it wherever it falls in the chart.
classical_check: Agrees: Aries is a sign of Mars.

hindi: मंगल दो नंबर जो है शुक्र का घर है। उसके बाहर नेम प्लेट शुक्र की है।
says: Sign 2, Taurus, is Venus's home and carries Venus's nameplate (the 'Mars' before 'two number' is a caption slip).
ambiguity: The caption says 'Mars, number two is Venus's home', where 'Mars' looks like leftover from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: Taurus is a sign of Venus.

hindi: हो सकता है इसमें आकर के यमराज रहता हो। हो सकता है सूर्य रहता हो। अब रहने वाला किराएदार आ सकता है।
says: Any other planet, such as Yama (Pluto) or the Sun, can come and live in a sign as a tenant while the sign's owner stays the landlord, so a planet in a sign is a tenant in someone else's home.
cells_derived_method: Reading depends on who the tenant is and whose home the sign is; the same tenant behaves differently in each owner's sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Capricorn (a Saturn home, where the Sun is an uneasy tenant) in the 1st house gives a stiff, duty-bound self.
Derived: Sun in Leo is in its own home in the 10th house (lagna Scorpio), so no tenant problem and an authoritative career image.

classical_check: Agrees with the classical sign-lord and graha-in-sign idea; the tenant image is his.

hindi: उस किराएदार ने उस घर का क्या हाल करना है? यह डिपेंड करता है। क्या उसकी उस मालिक से शत्रुता है या प्रेम है।
says: What a tenant planet does to the home depends on whether it is friendly or hostile to the owner, so the friendship between the planet and the sign lord decides the quality of the result.
cells_derived_method: For any planet in any sign, look up whether it is a friend, neutral or enemy of the sign lord: friend gives a helpful tenant, enemy a destructive one.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in Aquarius in the 7th house (lagna Leo), Saturn being Venus's friend, is a cooperative tenant, so a steady partnership with mutual respect.
Derived: Saturn in Aries, which is Saturn's debilitation sign and the home of its enemy Mars, in the 4th house (lagna Capricorn) is a hostile tenant, so strain at home.
Derived: Jupiter in Leo in the 9th house (lagna Sagittarius), Sun being Jupiter's friend, gives a respectful and productive tenant, good for dharma and luck.

ambiguity: He says 'friendship or love', so natural friendship is meant, not temporary or compound friendship.
classical_check: Agrees with naisargika friendship in sign dignity.

hindi: तो आपके ऐसे ही चौथे घर के अंदर क्या राशि है? किसका घर
says: Taking the 4th house as the worked example, he asks which sign is there and whose home it is; the sign's owner decides whose property the tenant lives in.
ambiguity: Question is cut off at 'whose home' and finishes in the next block.
classical_check: Agrees with the method of reading the house through its sign lord.

hindi: है? मंगल का घर है, शुक्र का घर है, शत्रु कौन सा है? उसमें आपने किराएदार को दे दिया।
says: Check whether the sign in the 4th house is Mars's home or Venus's home and who is the enemy of that owner, then see who you have let in as tenant.
cells_derived_method: The 4th house's sign decides its owner and thus which planets are enemies; the planet placed there is the tenant.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries as the 4th house means lagna Capricorn, Mars is the owner of the home; a Mercury tenant faces friction (Mercury is Mars's enemy) and a Sun, Moon or Jupiter tenant is friendly.
Derived: Taurus as the 4th house means lagna Aquarius, Venus owns the home; Mars, Sun and Moon tenants face friction (Sun and Moon are enemies of Venus) while Saturn and Mercury are friendly.

ambiguity: Mars and Venus are only examples he gives for 'whose home'; he does not tie them to the 4th house for every chart.
classical_check: Agrees with classical sign-lord friendship tables.

hindi: यदि किराएदार आपका गलत राशि वाला है और आपकी कुंडली खुद की कहती है कि चौथा घर जो है वो आपने अपना घर किराए पर दिया है और राशि गलत है तो आपको पागल कर देने वाला किराएदार मिलेगा।
says: If the planet in the 4th house sits in the wrong (hostile) sign, it is like renting out your own house to the wrong tenant, and you get a maddening tenant, meaning serious trouble in the 4th house matters.
cells_derived_method: Trouble appears when the 4th house holds an enemy or debilitated planet; severity rises with debilitation or enmity.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 4th house (lagna Capricorn) is the maddening tenant, with domestic restlessness and trouble from property and home.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 4th house (lagna Cancer) is a proud, cold tenant, with friction with mother and domestic dignity under strain.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 4th house (lagna Leo) is an emotionally intense, unsettled tenant, so uneasy mental peace at home.

ambiguity: 'Wrong sign' is not defined; read here as enemy or debilitated sign.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: planets in enemy or debilitated signs in the 4th house harm domestic happiness.

hindi: अच्छा ग्रह है तो बहुत मित्र प्रेम करने वाला। यदि कोई उच्च का ही बैठा है तो ऐसा लगेगा जैसे घर का सदस्य आ गया।
says: A good planet in the 4th house is a very friendly, loving tenant, and if it is exalted it feels like a family member has moved in.
cells_derived_method: A friendly or own-sign planet in the 4th gives warmth; an exalted one gives the best result.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 4th house (lagna Aquarius): deeply comforting home, strong bond with mother, like a family member.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries): wise, generous home life, with property and domestic peace.
Derived: Venus exalted in Pisces in the 4th house (lagna Sagittarius): a lovely, comfortable home with luxury and affection.

classical_check: Agrees: exalted planets in the 4th house give domestic happiness.

hindi: यार मेरे भाई बहन मुझे नहीं पूछते। इतना प्यार मिला है दोस्तों से, मित्र से, अपने किराएदार से जैसी भी स्थिति यह आपके चौथे घर पर डिपेंड करेगा।
says: People sometimes get more love from friends and even their tenant than from siblings, and how much warmth you get this way depends on the condition of your 4th house.
ambiguity: A quoted remark of a client's feelings, mixed in with the claim about the 4th house.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इस प्रकार सारे ग्रह काम करते हैं।
says: This landlord-tenant logic is how all the planets in all the houses work, not just in the 4th house.
cells_derived_method: Apply the sign-owner versus planet relation to every cell of the 12 x 12 grid.
classical_check: Agrees with the general method of judging a planet by its sign and the lord of that sign.

hindi: तो ये हृदय का स्थान है। ये हमारा गला है, ये ह्रदय है। हृदय यहां पर हमारा दिल बना हुआ है। यह दिल आपका दो नंबर और सात नंबर राशि पर बैठा हुआ है।
says: On the body-chart the heart sits at signs 2 and 7, Taurus and Libra, the two homes of Venus, so Venus is placed as the heart.
ambiguity: The numbers 2 and 7 are signs here; he points at a drawing, so the throat and heart references are visual.
classical_check: Differs: classical Kalapurusha puts the heart at Leo, not Taurus or Libra; Venus as karaka of the heart is also not standard.

gist: Remarks that the heart shape he drew is not how a heart really looks, but that is how it is being drawn.

hindi: इसके नीचे नाभि है हमारे। आग लगी हुई है। एक और आठ।
says: Below the heart is the navel, the fire centre, at signs 1 and 8, Aries and Scorpio, the two homes of Mars, so fire belongs to Mars.
ambiguity: 'One and eight' are taken as sign numbers, in line with 2 and 7 for the heart.
classical_check: Differs: classical Kalapurusha does not put the navel at Aries and Scorpio, but Mars as fire agrees.

hindi: नौ और 12 वाटर चक्र है। जल चक्र।
says: Signs 9 and 12, Sagittarius and Pisces, the two homes of Jupiter, are the water chakra, which matches his earlier giving of the sex and water chakra to Jupiter.
ambiguity: Sign numbers 9 and 12 assumed.
classical_check: Pisces being a water sign is standard; Sagittarius as water chakra is his own; chakra assignment is not classical Jyotish.

hindi: यह हमारा रूट चक्र है। यहां पर शुक्र ग्रह की प्लेसमेंट है।
says: This lowest spot is the root chakra and he places Venus there; the sentence is unclear about which signs it covers.
ambiguity: Contradicts his sign-2-and-7 heart placement for Venus; he may have meant a different planet or be misspoken, and the sign numbers are missing.
classical_check: Differs: Venus at the root chakra is not a standard mapping; Saturn or Mars are the usual root planets.

gist: Asks the audience to think how forceful the heartbeat is, and starts to say what is said about it.

hindi: कि दिल के अगर नस को काटा जाए तो ये इतनी 20ों मीटर ऊपर ... इतनी ऊंची खून की फुार फेंक सकती है। यानी कितने भयंकर प्रेशर से दिल पंप कर रहा है।
says: If a major heart vessel were cut, blood could spurt metres high, showing the huge pumping pressure of the heart, which he takes as a picture of Venus's strength.
ambiguity: The height (6 or 20 metres) is a loose number he admits people disagree on.
classical_check: A physiology remark, not Jyotish; Venus-as-heart is his scheme (classically the Sun rules the heart).

hindi: तो आपके दिल के अंदर कितना जबरदस्त शक्ति है कि पूरा जीवन चला रहा है।
says: The heart holds enormous power and runs the whole of life, so Venus as the heart is the engine of life.
classical_check: Differs: the heart is classically the Sun's domain.

hindi: कहते है ना बंदा मर गया शौक दो इसको झटका दो मंगल अग्नि फेंक के मारो सूर्य के द्वारा अग्नि बनती है और मंगल जो है वो इलेक्ट्रिसिटी करंट आ गया जैसे ही उसको करंट देते हैं मंगल शुक्र को फिर जगा देता है बोले हार्ट बीट वापिस आ गई
says: When a heart stops, a shock is given: the Sun makes the fire, Mars supplies the electric current, and Mars wakes Venus (the heart) again so the heartbeat returns; in his scheme Mars can revive Venus.
ambiguity: Analogy of defibrillation to planets; not a medical statement or a chart condition.
classical_check: Silent; not a classical principle.

hindi: कितनी फिल्मों में हमने देखा है बंदा गया हुआ है वो लौट आया मृत संजीवनी आपने शुक्र को जिंदा कर दिया
says: Like the revived person in films, the 'mrit sanjivani' power (reviving the dead) is Venus's, since Shukracharya holds it; reviving Venus means reviving life.
classical_check: Agrees: Shukracharya is the master of Mritasanjivani vidya in tradition.

hindi: वो कहता है प्रेमी डार्लिंग जान तुमसे मिलके तो मैं फिर जिंदा हो गया बच्चा मां की गोद में आके कहता है मां तूने मुझे पुनर्जीवित कर दिया। यह सब शुक्र है।
says: A lover feeling revived on meeting the beloved, or a child feeling brought back to life in the mother's lap, is all Venus, the power of affection to renew life.
classical_check: Consistent with Venus as love and comfort.

hindi: यदि आपकी कुंडली में शुक्र अच्छा है तो आप पुनर्जीवित कर सकते हो। दूसरे के चेहरे पर मुस्कान ले आते हैं। आप दूसरे को ऐसे खिला देते हैं।
says: With a good Venus in the chart you can revive others, bringing a smile to their faces and making them bloom.
ambiguity: 'Good Venus' is not defined by sign or house in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with a well-placed Venus giving charm and affection.

gist: Exclamation of delight that a flower has bloomed and life is fun, finishing the bloom image.

hindi: जहां कुंडली में शुक्र है उससे संबंधित हर चीज में आप फूल खिला देंगे।
says: A good Venus makes flowers bloom in everything related to the house where it sits, so the Venus house is where you bring happiness and success.
cells_derived_method: The blossoming appears in the topics of the house Venus occupies; sign dignity raises or lowers it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in own sign Libra in the 3rd house (lagna Leo): flowers bloom in communication, siblings, courage and creative effort.
Derived: Venus in own sign Taurus in the 10th house (lagna Leo): career flourishes with beauty, comfort, art and finance.
Derived: Venus exalted in Pisces in the 7th house (lagna Virgo): partnership and public dealing bloom, a loving spouse.

ambiguity: 'Good Venus' is not defined.
classical_check: Agrees with the general rule that a strong benefic improves the house it occupies.

hindi: और अगर शुक्र बुरा है तो जहां कुंडली में स्थित है वहां जाकर के कांटे चुभो दोगे।
says: If Venus is bad, you pierce thorns into the very area of life where it is placed, so an afflicted Venus damages the topics of its own house.
cells_derived_method: The damage lands on the house topics where Venus sits, and is worse with debilitation in Virgo or in dusthanas.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 5th house (lagna Taurus): thorns in romance, children matters and creativity, with criticism spoiling affection.
Derived: Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 2nd house (lagna Leo): thorns in family speech, money and food habits.
Derived: Venus in Aries (Mars's home) in the 8th house (lagna Virgo): thorns around sudden events, hidden matters and shared resources.

ambiguity: 'Bad Venus' is undefined (affliction, debilitation or dusthana).
classical_check: Agrees with the general idea that an afflicted planet damages its house.

hindi: क्योंकि कांटे जरूर चुभएगा। ये वो फूल नहीं है जो कांटे ना चुभए।
says: Thorns will certainly prick, since Venus is not the kind of flower without thorns, meaning even a good Venus comes with some pain or complication.
ambiguity: Unclear whether he means thorns come with every Venus or only when Venus is bad.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आदमी गाली बक के छोड़ भी सकता है। स्त्री तत्व ऐसा है। वह गाली बक के भी पकड़ के रखेगी।
says: A man may curse and walk away, but the feminine Venus principle will curse and still hold on, so Venus clings even in conflict.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए स्त्री पति के साथ क्लेश करने के बाद भी घर बसाती है। उसका गुण यही है। शुक्र छोड़ता नहीं।
says: That is why a wife keeps the home going even after quarrelling with her husband; Venus does not let go.
classical_check: Consistent with Venus as the karaka of marriage and home, though not stated as a rule.

hindi: इसलिए उससे तलाक लेना भी बहुत मुश्किल। यदि खराब हो गया है, व्यसन में डाल दिया तो आप व्यसन से भी तलाक नहीं ले पाएंगे।
says: For the same reason it is very hard to divorce Venus, and if Venus has turned bad and put you into an addiction (vyasan), you will not be able to break free from that addiction either.
ambiguity: 'Divorce' is used loosely for letting go; no chart condition for an afflicted Venus is given. It is a tradition claim about habits, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Consistent with Venus as the karaka of indulgence and vices; the stickiness claim is his own.

gist: Repeats that whether you are a woman or a man you cannot shake off the addiction, and that this becomes a special problem.

hindi: तो शुक्र ग्रह हृदय आप कुछ भी शरीर में कर रहे हैं। हृदय अपने आप ध्यान देता है। हृदय का मुख्य कार्य क्या है? इस पूरे शरीर के अंदर संजीवनी डाल के रखना।
says: Venus is the heart, which looks after itself automatically whatever you do with the body, and its main job is to keep sanjivani, life-giving force, flowing through the entire body.
classical_check: Differs: the heart is classically the Sun's domain; Venus as life-renewing force is his own and echoes the Mritasanjivani idea.

hindi: कितना अब्यूज करते हैं, गंध खाते हैं हम। कितना कुछ खराब चीजें पीते हैं। कितनी गाली बकते हैं। कितना ज्यादा मन कुड़ाते हैं। कहते हैं दिल फट गया। उसके बावजूद भी शुक्र कहता है नहीं आखिर तक चलूंगा।
says: We abuse the body with bad food, bad drinks, curses and fretting, and say our heart has burst, yet Venus (the heart) keeps going to the very end, so Venus stands for stubborn endurance.
ambiguity: Venus is equated with the heart here, as in his earlier sentences, not the usual Sun.
classical_check: Differs: the heart is classically the Sun's; Venus as the heart is his own mapping.

hindi: हॉस्पिटल में ... इंटेंसिव कोरोनरी केयर हार्ट के लिए एक अलग आईसीयू होता है कि बंदे की टांग नहीं चल रही, दिमाग नहीं चल रहा। आंखें बंद है। टूट फूट हो रखी है। दिल चल रहा है भाई जिंदा है।
says: In an intensive care unit a patient may have non-working legs and brain, closed eyes and broken body, but the heart is still beating and he is alive, an example of Venus being the last to give up.
ambiguity: Illustration only; not a prediction of any health event.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यानी आपका शुक्र आपकी उस चीज को जिंदा रखता है।
says: Your Venus keeps alive the particular thing it governs in your chart, so the matter of the house where Venus sits survives even when other areas collapse.
cells_derived_method: The area kept alive is the topic of the house that holds Venus, with the sign colouring how it survives.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in its own sign Taurus in the 7th house (lagna Scorpio): marriage and partnership keep surviving through strains.
Derived: Venus in Aries (Mars's home) in the 10th house (lagna Cancer): career keeps going through effort and restarts.
Derived: Venus in Scorpio in the 4th house (lagna Leo): home and the bond with mother survive through emotional intensity and hidden strain.

ambiguity: 'That thing' refers back to Venus's house, which he does not name here.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with house-based karaka reading.

hindi: आपने गुरु से कृपा ले ली। हम गुरु बनाते रहते हैं। भाई गुरुजी बनाओ। गुरुजी बनाओ।
says: Seeking a guru's grace and constantly making new gurus is the Jupiter way, where Jupiter is the teacher you go to.
ambiguity: 'Make a guru' is used humorously; he sets up a contrast with Venus in the next sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the guru karaka.

hindi: शुक्र कैसे बनाओ? शुक्र कहता है मैं चेले बनाऊंगा। गुरु बनाने के चक्कर ही नहीं साले तुम्हारी ऐसी की तैसी कूट कूट के सेट करूंगा।
says: Venus does not go looking for a guru; it takes people as disciples and thrashes them into shape, so the Venus mode is to make followers rather than to be taught.
classical_check: Silent; echoes his earlier Venus-as-commander image.

gist: Leads into a question of why women keep the Karva Chauth fast and men do not, answered in the next block.

hindi: आजकल हालांकि कई बंदे हैं जो कहते हैं मैं तेरे लिए करवा चौथ रख रहा हूं। अरे भाई ... पत्नी के लिए करवा चौथ नहीं रख रखा जाता। तू शुक्र नहीं है।
says: Men who say they keep Karva Chauth for their wife are wrong: the fast is not kept by a husband for his wife, because he is not Venus; he gives the instruction not to do it (tradition claim).
ambiguity: No chart condition; it is a gender-role instruction tied to Venus being the female principle.
classical_check: Silent in classical Jyotish; Karva Chauth is a folk and religious custom, not a Jyotish remedy.

hindi: तू उसका सत्यानाश कर देगा बहन का। उसे पता भी नहीं चलेगा। और वो तू उसमें ईगो भर रहा है। जो बृहस्पति घुसा रहा है अंदर।
says: A husband fasting for his wife will ruin her without her even noticing, because he is stuffing Jupiter's ego into her; he claims the male fast injects Jupiter energy into the woman (tradition claim).
ambiguity: 'Ego' is read as Jupiter's pride; the mechanism is stated only as an analogy.
classical_check: Silent; not a classical Jyotish principle.

hindi: तुम्हारी सेक्स लाइफ का सत्यानाश हो जाएगा और तू उससे व्रत रखवा करके अपना शुक्र तत्व पकड़ रहा है।
says: The couple's sex life will be wrecked, since by making her fast he is taking hold of the Venus element for himself; he claims the fast hands the Venus role to the man (tradition claim, not a medical statement).
ambiguity: Garbled in places; 'you' and 'she' shift between husband and wife.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बॉडी कंफ्यूज हो जाएगी कि ये बॉडी स्त्री की पुरुष की तरह काम चलाना है या पुरुष की बॉडी स्त्री की तरह ... स्त्री में प्रजनन क्षमता लिबिडो खत्म हो जाएगा।
says: The body gets confused about whether to work as a male or female body, and he claims the woman's fertility and libido can vanish; recorded as his claim and not a medical finding.
ambiguity: The man's sperm line is garbled ('whose sperm will fall'); only the loss of fertility and libido for women is clear.
classical_check: Silent; a health claim with no classical basis, not to be used as medical advice.

hindi: सर ये कंपैशन कंपैशन? ज्यादा पैशन होना चाहिए। पैशन की क्लास कर रहे हैं। आप कौन से कंपैशन पे चले गए?
says: Venus is the passion planet, not the compassion planet: this class is about passion, so Venus's trait is passionate desire, with compassion being a Jupiter matter.
ambiguity: Said as an aside to an audience member; the Jupiter link to compassion is implied.
classical_check: Agrees that Venus is passion and desire and Jupiter is compassion and grace.

gist: Back-and-forth with an audience member about parents who do everything for children while the children cause trouble.

hindi: आपने 50 से ऊपर किया है। उन्हें करने की जरूरत ही नहीं। वो 100 का 100 आप कर दिया। बच्चे हमारे लिए क्यों कुछ करेंगे? बच्चे अपने बच्चों के लिए करेंगे।
says: A parent who has already given more than the 50 percent share has done 100 percent, so the children owe little back and will do their giving for their own children; an example of an unbalanced 50-50 exchange.
ambiguity: The 50 here is the balance idea from earlier, not a chart value.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Quips that we get beaten by our children and they get beaten by theirs.

hindi: आपस में रिश्ता बनाने का तालमेल बृहस्पति और शुक्र की समन्वयता से है।
says: The harmony needed to build relationships between people comes from the coordination of Jupiter and Venus, so relationships succeed when these two work together.
ambiguity: No chart link (conjunction or aspect) is named.
classical_check: Consistent with Jupiter and Venus as the two relationship benefics; not a stated classical rule.

hindi: दोनों कैसे संभल के चल सकते हैं? यदि आप दोनों को कोलेशन में बिठा सकते हैं तब चलेगा जीवन। अगर वो आपको नहीं आता आप बर्बाद हो जाओगे।
says: If you can seat Jupiter and Venus together in a working coalition, life runs well, and if you cannot manage that you will be ruined, so the Jupiter-Venus balance decides success or failure.
ambiguity: 'Ruined' is rhetorical; no chart condition for failure.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और इन दोनों जो मित्र नहीं है शत्रु शब्द नहीं कहूंगा। इन दोनों को संभालना कितना जटिल।
says: Jupiter and Venus are not friends, though he will not call them enemies, and handling the pair is very complex.
cells_derived_method: When either planet is placed in the other's home, the unfriendly relation applies, so the tenant-owner logic reads uneasy for them.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Venus's home Libra in the 3rd house (lagna Leo): an uneasy tenant, so wisdom and ethics clash with pleasure and ease in efforts and communication.
Derived: Venus in Jupiter's home Sagittarius in the 11th house (lagna Aquarius): Venus is a slightly uneasy tenant, with desires for gain moderated by principle.
Derived: Jupiter in Taurus in the 5th house (lagna Capricorn): Jupiter in an unfriendly home, so intellect and children matters are tied up with material comfort.

classical_check: Agrees: in Parashari friendships Jupiter treats Venus as an enemy and Venus treats Jupiter as neutral.

gist: Starts the Kacha story: Brihaspati sent his son Kacha to Shukracharya to learn Mritasanjivani.

hindi: शुक्र सिखाएगा और दोनों एक दूसरे के दुश्मन है। दोनों के डिसाइपल्स एक दूसरे के दुश्मन है।
says: Venus (guru of the demons) and Jupiter (guru of the gods) are rivals, and the disciples of the two are enemies of each other too.
ambiguity: Here he calls them enemies, after refusing the word a moment earlier.
classical_check: Agrees with the Puranic story and with Jupiter-Venus enmity in the friendship table; slightly contradicts his own earlier 'I will not say enemy'.

gist: Says a true guru knows the two sets of children are enemies and still sent his own child to Shukracharya.
Remarks how beautiful these stories are.

hindi: बृहस्पति क्या है? लिवर। लिवर के अंदर हम कोलेस्ट्रॉल के स्यापे से परेशान होते
says: Jupiter is the liver, and we get troubled by cholesterol trouble inside the liver, which he sets as the body part ruled by Jupiter.
ambiguity: Sentence flows into the next block.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the classical karaka of the liver and fat.

hindi: कोलेस्ट्रॉल बनता कहां है? लिवर में बनता है। अरे हार्ट में थोड़ी बनता है। वो तो दो चार पांच पैसे बनाती है।
says: Cholesterol is made in the liver, Jupiter's organ, not in the heart, which makes only a trifle, so cholesterol belongs to the Jupiter domain.
ambiguity: A physiology remark used to place cholesterol under Jupiter, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Consistent with Jupiter as the karaka of fat and the liver.

hindi: तो ये स्यापा क्या है आपका? आपका जुपिटर नाराज है तो आपका कोलेस्ट्रॉल बढ़ा हुआ है।
says: If your Jupiter is displeased (afflicted), your cholesterol is raised; he links high cholesterol to a troubled Jupiter (recorded as his claim, not a diagnosis).
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's affliction is judged by its sign dignity and house, with the debilitation sign Capricorn and the dusthana houses the worst places.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 6th house (lagna Leo): both a weak sign and a house of disease, so this is where his claim would fire strongest.
Derived: Jupiter in Venus's home Taurus in the 2nd house (lagna Aries): an uneasy tenant in the food and speech house, mild indulgence tendencies under his claim.

ambiguity: 'Angry Jupiter' is not defined as a chart condition.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter afflictions are classically linked with fat and liver trouble; this is a health claim, not a diagnosis.

hindi: हम हार्ट का इलाज करने में लगे हुए हैं। अरे तेल लेने गई हार्ट। यह लीवर का लफड़ा है भाई। आपको बृहस्पति के इलाज करने हैं।
says: People treat the heart when the real problem is the liver, so one should treat Jupiter instead; recorded as his health opinion, not endorsed as medical advice, and the details are deferred to the Jupiter class.
ambiguity: 'Treating Jupiter' is both a medical and a planetary remedy; the method is not given here.
classical_check: Silent; a health claim and not a remedy from classical Jyotish.

gist: Says they will discuss Jupiter's treatment in the Jupiter class.
Resumes the Kacha story: Kacha is sent to Shukra, and Shukra's daughter Devayani falls in love with him.
Shukra realises Kacha is his enemy's son sent to take Mritasanjivani, yet as a guru he teaches him anyway.

hindi: यह ज्ञान ही अलग किस्म का है। तो ज्ञान ज्ञान है। चाहे कंस्ट्रक्टिव है, चाहे डिस्ट्रक्टिव है। आप कैसे लेते हैं उस पर डिपेंड करता है।
says: Knowledge is simply knowledge, whether constructive or destructive; its outcome depends on how the receiver uses it, and Shukra's special knowledge is of this neutral kind.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Repeats the greatness of Shukra, who educates even his enemy's son.
Devayani asks Kacha to marry; he comes out by tearing Shukra's belly and refuses because he was born from her father, with a remark that going into the story would take time.

hindi: तो हार्ट क्या करता है? आपके अंदर की सारी गंदगी को झेलता है।
says: The heart (Venus) bears all the filth that builds up inside you, so Venus's role is to tolerate and absorb the body's and mind's impurities.
classical_check: Differs: the heart is classically the Sun's; the absorbing role is his own.

gist: Names heart medicines and tonics taken for cholesterol, with product names, as a side note.

hindi: इसके लिए होम्योपैथिक लिवर का इलाज करो। आप लिवर को करेक्शन करके दोगे वो हार्ट को तंग करना छोड़ देगा। हार्ट फिर भी झेलेगी।
says: He advises treating the liver (for example homeopathically), after which the liver stops troubling the heart, which keeps bearing the load anyway; recorded as his medical opinion, not endorsed.
ambiguity: Mixes a medical and a planetary remedy, with no dose or method.
classical_check: Silent; medical advice outside Jyotish.

hindi: और हार्ट तंग क्यों हो रहा है? क्योंकि उसने स्यापे ले रखे हैं। स्यापा मींस टॉक्सिन। आपने कुछ खचरपचर खा लिया। लिवर बाइल फेंक देता है। लिवर फटाफट बिलरबिन सेट करता है।
says: The heart is troubled because it carries toxins, from eating junk, which the liver handles by throwing out bile and quickly setting bilirubin right; he sets out the liver's cleaning job as Jupiter's job.
ambiguity: A physiology explanation, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Mentions liver enzyme tests (OT/PT) and says there is no need to go into them.

hindi: लिवर कहता है मेरा अपना ब्रेन है भाई। मैं अपने आप सेट करूंगा तुम्हारी बॉडी की गंदगी। वो सारी गंदगी धो देता है।
says: The liver has a brain of its own and cleans up the body's dirt automatically, which shows Jupiter's self-regulating, purifying nature.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across the block break.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with Jupiter as a purifier in a loose sense.

hindi: शुक्र करता है पार्टी गंदगी तो लाइफ का हिस्सा अंदर भी आया भाई मजे करेंगे।
says: Venus throws a party and accepts that some dirt comes in as part of life; its attitude is to enjoy anyway and let the liver deal with the dirt.
classical_check: Agrees with Venus as the karaka of indulgence.

gist: Says we are enjoying and stuff oily rich food, then create a fuss.

hindi: गंदगी जैसे ही लीवर देखता है हार्ट में टॉक्सिन आ गए। खाने के नहीं आए। टेंशन के आ गए, स्ट्रेस के आ गए, क्लेश के आ गए, तनाव के आ गए। विशेष तौर पर प्रेम के आ गए। क्योंकि हृदय में प्रेम होता है।
says: The toxins that reach the heart are emotional, not from food: tension, stress, strife and strain, especially those of love, because love lives in the heart; so Venus collects emotional pollution.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: उसी टाइम लीवर कहता है ले मैंने ठोक दिया माल। अब वो माल एक्स्ट्रा भेज दिया। वो कोलेस्ट्रॉल जो बॉडी को हेल्दी रखता है। वो बॉडी में एक्स्ट्रा चला गया
says: When emotional toxins hit the heart, the liver reacts by sending extra cholesterol, which then circulates in excess; a troubled Venus (heart) makes Jupiter (liver) over-produce (recorded as his claim, not a diagnosis).
ambiguity: A physiological story used as a planetary interaction; no chart condition given.
classical_check: Silent; medical claim with no classical basis.

hindi: और हार्ट के अंदर जो एनर्जीस है वो हमने ठीक की नहीं। हम एनर्जी के द्वारा क्रिएटेड गंदगी जो हार्ट से निकाल नहीं रहे हैं। बुरा बोलना, कोसना, कुड़ना, सड़ना, दिल फाड़ना, क्रोध करना।
says: We have not corrected the energies in the heart and are not clearing the dirt they create: speaking ill, cursing, fuming, rotting and breaking hearts, and anger; these habits pollute Venus.
ambiguity: A list of behaviours, with no remedy given in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्रोध करना बृहस्पति का गुण है। शुक्र कुपित हो जाता है।
says: Getting angry is a Jupiter quality, while Venus becomes upset and agitated, so anger's source is credited to Jupiter and its victim to Venus.
ambiguity: Anger as Jupiter's quality is unusual and may be a slip for Mars.
classical_check: Differs: anger is classically a Mars (and Sun) trait; Jupiter is calm.

hindi: बृहस्पति तो सभा छोड़ के चले जाते हैं। अगर गुस्सा आया और कोई बंदा गाली बकबगा के छोड़ के चला गया वो जुपिटर पावरफुल है उसका। कोई कह
says: Jupiter leaves the assembly when angry, so a person who curses and walks away has a powerful Jupiter, in contrast to Venus, which holds on; the sentence is cut off at 'someone says'.
ambiguity: The caption ends mid-sentence.
classical_check: Silent; it follows his own Jupiter-leaves versus Venus-holds contrast.

hindi: रहा है मैं ना जाऊंगा मैं भाई मार दूंगा मर जाऊंगा। वो शुक्र है।
says: The obstinate emotional threat 'I will not go, I will die, I will kill myself' is Venus, the planet that digs in and uses emotional pressure to get its way.
ambiguity: Caption begins mid-sentence, so what 'is going on' is lost; the threat is a figure of speech used to illustrate stubbornness.
classical_check: Silent; stubborn emotional bargaining is not a classical Venus significator.

hindi: तो वहां पर आपके कोलेस्ट्रॉल हार्ट को डिस्ट्रॉय कर रहा है। एनर्जी बॉडी से क्रिएट हुआ है। इसलिए एनर्जी बॉडी को पहले ठीक करो।
says: Cholesterol is damaging the heart, but it was created by the energy body, so one should fix the energy body first; recorded as his health claim, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'Energy body' is a yogic notion; no method for fixing it is given in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent; not a Jyotish remedy and not medical advice.

hindi: कुड़ो नहीं, सड़ो नहीं, चंचल रहो।
says: Do not fume and do not rot inside; stay light and lively, which is his short instruction to keep Venus healthy.
ambiguity: 'Chanchal' means playful or lively, not restless.
classical_check: Silent; a behavioural instruction rather than a classical Venus remedy.

hindi: मृदु भाषी कितने प्यार से बात की जाती है। आप विशेष देखेंगे उर्दू जबान है, फारसी जबान है। कितनी मधुरता है। संस्कृत बड़ी स्वीट है।
says: Soft, loving speech is Venus; he points to the sweetness of Urdu, Persian and Sanskrit as examples of the Venus quality in language.
ambiguity: Venus is implied, not named, in this sentence; the context is Venus's sweet speech.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is the karaka of sweet speech and refined language.

gist: Says other languages are corrupted forms, with Haryanvi and Bihari coming out of Hindi, and Devanagari being written differently.

hindi: ये सारा का सारा जो जड़ है वो जुपिटर और शुक्र का है।
says: The root of all this refined speech and language belongs to Jupiter and Venus together.
ambiguity: 'All this' refers to the sweet language just mentioned.
classical_check: Consistent with Jupiter for speech and learning and Venus for sweetness; Mercury is the usual language planet.

hindi: जुपिटर बैलेंसिंग करता है पूरे के पूरे सोलर सिस्टम की। यानी जुपिटर चाहता है तो शुक्र भी सेट रहता है।
says: Jupiter balances the entire solar system, and by that logic when Jupiter wishes it, Venus also stays in order; Jupiter is the stabiliser of Venus.
ambiguity: Mixes an astronomy remark (Jupiter's mass) with a chart claim.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; Jupiter as the great benefic that restrains afflictions is a familiar idea.

hindi: यानी जिसकी कुंडली में जुपिटर सही है उसका शुक्र उपद्रव भी नहीं करेगा। अय्याशी भी बड़ी कंट्रोल्ड करेगा के ताऊ जी देख रहे हैं।
says: In a chart where Jupiter is well placed, Venus will not cause trouble either, and the person will keep indulgence under control, as if an elder were watching.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter is judged strong by sign dignity (Cancer, Sagittarius, Pisces) and by good houses; the stronger it is, the more it restrains Venus's excess.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 1st house (lagna Cancer): the strongest restraining influence, so self-control over Venus's pleasures.
Derived: Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius in the 9th house (lagna Aries): strong dharma and principles keep Venus's indulgence in check.
Derived: Jupiter in its own sign Pisces in the 4th house (lagna Sagittarius): a calm, restrained home life keeps indulgence modest.

ambiguity: 'Right Jupiter' is not defined by him as a precise condition.
classical_check: Consistent with a strong Jupiter reducing the harm of Venus; not a stated classical rule.

hindi: इंद्र सेट रहता है। इंद्र तो अय्याशी करा देता है। इंद्र बिल्कुल सेट रहता है। जुपिटर इतना पावरफुल है।
says: Indra (Uranus) would normally push a person into debauchery, but with a strong Jupiter even Uranus stays perfectly in order, which shows how powerful Jupiter is.
ambiguity: 'Set' means in order or under control.
classical_check: Uranus is not classical; Jupiter restraining other planets is a general idea.

hindi: लेकिन जुपिटर की सबसे बड़ी खासियत है। वो जिद्द मार करके अपने पे छोड़ देता है। कहता है मरो फिर।
says: Jupiter's greatest trait is that when someone is stubborn it leaves them to their own fate and says 'then go die', so Jupiter withdraws and lets you face the result.
ambiguity: A figure of speech; 'die' means face the consequences.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और शुक्र कहता है मरो तो सही। प्लीज एक बार मरो तो सही। मैं जिंदा करूं तुम्हें दोबारा। यह चीजें दोनों ग्रहों की बहुत ज्यादा उलट है।
says: Venus says go ahead and die once, I will bring you back to life, which is the reverse of Jupiter's walking away; the two planets are extreme opposites in how they treat a failing person.
classical_check: Echoes Venus as the holder of Mritasanjivani and Jupiter as the guru of devas; a rhetorical contrast.

hindi: इसलिए शुक्र की कृपा से आपका हृदय चल रहा है। आपका प्रेम चल रहा है और दिल बलियां खा रहा है।
says: It is by Venus's grace that your heart keeps beating, your love goes on and your heart leaps with joy, so heartbeat and love are both credited to Venus.
classical_check: Venus as the karaka of love agrees; the heartbeat attribution is his own.

hindi: छोटा बच्चा शिशु जिसमें रज या वीर्य पुरुष और स्त्री कन्या में नहीं बना। वो सारे टाइम खुश होते हैं।
says: Small children in whom semen or the female reproductive fluid has not yet formed are happy all the time, so for him unspoiled joy belongs to the pre-formed state of Venus.
ambiguity: The link between absence of the fluid and constant happiness is unclear; the sentence is run-on.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हम खुशी के मारे ताली पीटते हैं। ये हमारे विंग्स है। हृदय के एक्सटेंशन हम कहते हैं वाह मजा आ गया। यह हमारा शुक्र है।
says: We clap in joy because our hands are the wings or extensions of the heart, and that 'wow, what fun' reaction is Venus, so joyful gestures are the heart's outward expression.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए आप अपने जीवन में जितनी भी चीजें बना रहे हैं जिसमें वैभव है, संपन्नता है, आनंद है, मस्ती है। ये सारी चीजें शुक्र के द्वारा बनती है।

hindi: आनंद शब्द भी इसमें आता है। क्योंकि शुक्र के रूप में भी आनंद आता है। आप जब अपने परस्पर प्रेमी के साथ है तो भी आनंद है।

hindi: इसलिए आपके अपने स्वभाव के द्वारा ही शुक्र डिसाइड करके देगा कि आपके जीवन में चीजें तो देनी है। क्या एंजॉयमेंट भी देनी है या नहीं देनी है।

hindi: अगर आपका शुक्र डिस्टर्ब है तो आपका पैंकक्रियास खराब हो जाता है। आपको शुगर की बीमारी हो जाती है।
says: If your Venus is disturbed your pancreas is damaged and you get sugar disease (diabetes); recorded as his health claim, not a diagnosis.

Derived: Venus exalted in Pisces in the 2nd house (lagna Aquarius): strong, so the claim would not fire, with sweets and food as simple enjoyment.

ambiguity: 'Disturbed' is undefined; a health claim and not a diagnosis.

hindi: यदि आप कंप्लेंट करते हैं तो याद रखें शुक्र कितना गर्म ग्रह है। 470 डिग्री पर रहता है। 471 एक्सैक्ट

hindi: हमारे बॉडी के सीक्वेंस में ये हमारी थर्ड आई है। तीसरा नेत्र यह हमारा आकाश तत्व है।

hindi: यहां शनि महाराज बैठे हैं। यहां बृहस्पति है, मंगल है, शुक्र है, बुध है। राहु भी है, वरुण भी है, इंद्र भी है, केतु भी है और साथ में यमराज भी है।
