says: The real result of Mars with Venus is a power house: the person locks onto one task with full focus and will not drop it until it is finished; persistence and single-mindedness.
cells_derived_method: The task is set by the house: 10th career, 4th property or study, 6th competition, 3rd skills or media; sign strength sets how long the drive lasts.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars and Venus in the 10th in Taurus (lagna Leo) shows a person who sticks to one career project to the end; Venus in own sign.
Derived: Mars and Venus in the 3rd in Aries (lagna Aquarius) shows relentless effort in one skill or venture; Mars in own sign.
Derived: Mars and Venus in the 4th in Capricorn (lagna Libra) shows obsessive focus on property or a home project; Mars exalted.

classical_check: Partly agrees; classical texts give energy and determination to Mars but not this specific single-task obsession.

hindi: उल्टा उसके साथ ये स्थिति बनती है कि इसका हार्ट इतना अट्रैक्ट करता है चीजों को कि कॉस्मोस से वो एक मांगता है दो मिलती हैं।
says: The flip side: the heart of such a person attracts things so strongly that when they ask the cosmos for one thing, two arrive; Mars-fired Venus (heart) gives a magnet effect that over-delivers.
cells_derived_method: The things attracted follow the house: 2nd wealth, 4th property, 5th children or romance, 7th partners; sign sets quality.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars and Venus in the 2nd in Libra (lagna Virgo) means asking for a little money and receiving double; Venus in own sign.
Derived: Mars and Venus in the 7th in Taurus (lagna Scorpio) means a request for one partner can bring more than one admirer; Venus in own sign.

ambiguity: Heart is here linked to Venus, as in his heart-Venus body mapping.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में ही एक्स्ट्रा मैरिटल अफेयर भी दे देता है। क्योंकि वो एक भी गलती से मांग ले दो मिलते हैं।
says: He says the same over-delivery can produce an extra-marital affair: if such a person even mistakenly wishes for one partner, two arrive; recorded as his claim, not advice.
cells_derived_method: Most relevant when the Mars-Venus pair sits in the 7th or 12th, or aspects the 7th, since these houses carry partnership and bed pleasures; Venus or Mars in dual signs (Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces) adds doubling.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars and Venus in the 7th in Gemini (lagna Sagittarius) gives a doubling tendency in partnerships.
Derived: Mars and Venus in the 12th in Pisces (lagna Aries) puts the doubling in private bed pleasures; Venus exalted.

ambiguity: Dual-sign link is my derivation, not his.
classical_check: Agrees in part; classical texts connect Mars-Venus with multiple relationships.

hindi: ऐसे लोग हैं और इसी की मल्टीिसिपिलिटी यदि इसके अंतर्गत शुक्र के साथ यहां पर वरुण की कृपा हो जाए। वरुण यहां है। सात नंबर राशि यहां है यहां वरुण भी है।
says: If Venus also gets the grace of Neptune (Varuna), the multiplying effect grows further; he points to the sign numbered 7, Libra, which has Venus and Neptune together as its lords.
cells_derived_method: Venus and Neptune together in Libra are placed in a house; the house sets what is multiplied (2nd wealth, 4th property, 10th status), and Venus ownership of Libra makes the multiplication natural.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus and Neptune in Libra in the 4th (lagna Cancer) multiplies homes and vehicles.
Derived: Venus and Neptune in Libra in the 10th (lagna Capricorn) multiplies career reach and public status.

ambiguity: Libra is called seven number sign here; he points to it on the board, so I take sign 7.
classical_check: Outside the classical set; Neptune is not used and Libra's lord is Venus only.

hindi: ये अगर वरुण के साथ कृपा मिल जाए कुंडली में वरुण बहुत अच्छा बैठा हुआ है आपका नेप्च्यून तो आप मान के चल आपने एक मकान मांगा तो एक तो आपको बॉम्बे में दे दिया एक दिल्ली में दे दिया एक इटली में भी बंगला दे दिया।
says: If Neptune is well placed in the chart and joins Venus, a request for one house is answered with several: one in Bombay, one in Delhi and a bungalow in Italy; Neptune multiplies what Venus attracts.
cells_derived_method: Reading applies to the 4th house and its lord and to Venus; Neptune well placed means in a kendra, trikona or own-like sign. Different houses change the asset type.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune and Venus in the 4th in Pisces (lagna Sagittarius) gives several properties and homes abroad; Venus exalted.
Derived: Neptune and Venus in the 11th in Taurus (lagna Cancer) gives many gains and property income from several places.

ambiguity: What well placed means is not defined.
classical_check: Outside the classical set.

hindi: यह इतना बड़ा ह्यूमंगस इतना बड़ा बिग साइज कर देता है आपका।
says: Neptune makes everything enormous: a very big, humongous size to the person's wealth, assets and scale of life.
ambiguity: Humungous is a Devanagari spelling of the English word.
classical_check: Outside the classical set.

hindi: इसलिए सोच के चल शुक्र की कृपा के लिए आपको इंद्र की कृपा भी चाहिए।
says: For Venus to bless fully, he says you also need Uranus (Indra) favourable; Venus results are incomplete without Indra support.
cells_derived_method: Look at Uranus relation to Venus (conjunction, aspect, Scorpio link) in the house under study.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries) gets fuller marriage results if Uranus also supports from the same or an aspecting house.

classical_check: Outside the classical set.

hindi: लेकिन इंद्र के साथ क्या है? यह थोड़ा डिस्टर्बिंग है क्योंकि आठ नंबर राशि सात के साथ खराबी रखती है। दो के साथ नहीं रखती। लगभग खराबी जैसा रखती है।
says: The problem with Uranus is that its sign number 8, Scorpio, creates trouble with sign 7, Libra, but not with sign 2, Taurus; he then softens it to say it holds almost a spoiling relation.
cells_derived_method: Scorpio and Libra are adjacent signs (Scorpio 2nd from Libra), while Taurus is the opposite sign to Scorpio; Venus in Libra gets disturbed by Uranus-Scorpio, Venus in Taurus does not.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries) with Uranus nearby in Scorpio would see disturbance in marriage.
Derived: Venus in Taurus in the 2nd (lagna Aries) with Uranus in Scorpio opposite would be less disturbed per his remark.

ambiguity: Numbers can be sign numbers (8, 7, 2) or house numbers; here they are most likely signs. The caption also contradicts itself with no trouble then almost trouble.
classical_check: Outside the classical set.

hindi: मंगल भी शुक्र को अग्नि जला के ऐसी की तैसी फेलता है। ये घी है तो ये आग है। इसको सुखाता है। लेकिन वो बर्न करता है।
says: Mars also burns Venus with its fire and can ruin it; he uses the image of ghee (Venus) and fire (Mars): fire dries and burns the ghee, so Mars can scorch Venus qualities if overdone.
cells_derived_method: The burn is strongest where Mars is strong or debilitated-harsh over Venus in the same house, and the house shows what is scorched (7th marriage, 2nd family wealth, 4th comfort).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars and Venus in the 7th in Scorpio (lagna Taurus) can scorch marriage comfort with sharp conflict.
Derived: Mars and Venus in the 4th in Cancer (lagna Aries) can burn domestic peace; Mars debilitated there.

ambiguity: This slightly contradicts the benefit he gave a minute ago; he means moderate fire helps, excess burns.
classical_check: Agrees in part; classical texts also warn of Mars affliction to Venus in marriage.

hindi: सारा खाना बनता कैसे है? आपने घी डाला। तेल भी डलता है। घी डाला। अब घी के नीचे क्या आग लगा दी? सारी पौष्टिकता, सारे भोजन का रस, सारे भोजन का स्वाद, सारे मसाले और आ स्वर्ग मिल गया खा के पी के।
says: Cooking analogy: ghee and oil without a flame is nothing, but fire under the ghee brings out all the nourishment, taste and flavour of the food, which is heaven; so Mars fire is what makes Venus enjoyable.
classical_check: Silent; analogy is his own.

hindi: सारा शुक्र है। यह बनता ही उससे। इसलिए मंगल की अग्नि के बिना वीरे और रज भी सुखदायक नहीं है।
says: All of the dish is Venus, and it only comes out through Mars fire; thus without Mars fire even semen and ovum fluid (vir and raj, Venus substances) are not pleasurable.
ambiguity: Vire is probably veerya; captions are rough.
classical_check: Partly agrees; Venus is the karaka of semen and reproductive fluids in tradition, Mars of heat and drive.

hindi: सारे टाइम हार्ट की करेक्शन के लिए क्या बोलते हैं? दौड़ो, भागो, नाभि स्ट्रांग करो, पंपिंग करो, तेज तेज सांस लो।
says: For correcting the heart (Venus) the advice is to run, sprint, strengthen the navel, pump and breathe fast; this is a Mars-type exercise remedy for a weak Venus or heart.
cells_derived_method: Remedy applies when Venus is weak or Mars is needed to energise it; not house-dependent.
ambiguity: This reads as general fitness advice mixed with astrology; he does not state a chart condition for using it.
classical_check: Silent; not a classical remedy.

hindi: आपका मंगल ही शुक्र को सेट भी रखता है। यह पत्नी है जो सीता माता उठा के ले गया। रावण लंका ले गया। ये हनुमान जी है जिसको संभाल के रखते हैं।
says: Your Mars also keeps Venus in order: he compares Venus to the wife like Sita carried off by Ravana to Lanka, and Mars to Hanuman who keeps her safe and holds things together.
cells_derived_method: Protection of Venus matters in houses where Venus is vulnerable (7th spouse, 12th); a strong Mars in or aspecting these houses gives the guard.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in the 7th in Capricorn (lagna Cancer) guards the spouse and home life like Hanuman.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 12th in Aries (lagna Taurus) protects Venus pleasures and private life.

ambiguity: Who is Ravana in chart terms is not said; the story is an analogy.
classical_check: Silent; Hanuman as Mars deity is a tradition link.

hindi: यदि कंस्ट्रक्टिव वे में मंगल आपकी कुंडली में पड़ा है तो इतने बड़े प्रोटेक्टर्स मिल जाएंगे आपको। आप स्त्री है चाहे पुरुष है। आपके पास हमेशा तेरा भाई होगा।
says: If Mars lies in a constructive (benefic-supported) way in the chart, you get big protectors, whether you are man or woman, and there will always be a brother-like helper by your side.
cells_derived_method: Mars constructive means placed in own, exalted or friendly signs or in kendra and trikona; the 3rd house shows brothers, 11th friends, so Mars strong there directs protectors that way.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign in the 3rd in Aries (lagna Aquarius) gives bold brothers and helpers.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 11th in Scorpio (lagna Capricorn) gives protective friends and well-wishers.
Derived: Mars exalted in the 10th in Capricorn (lagna Aries) gives powerful official backers.

ambiguity: What constructive means is not defined.
classical_check: Agrees; Mars is karaka of brothers and protection.

hindi: एक हमेशा भाई रक्षा करने आएगा। दोस्त होंगे। भाई आया तेरा बता यार तू पंगा बता भाई। अपन लोग चलेंगे तेरे साथ।
says: Illustrating that a strong Mars means a brother or friends will always come to defend you; he acts out the friend saying tell me who your trouble is with, we will go with you.
classical_check: Agrees; Mars signifies brothers and courageous friends.

hindi: इसलिए मंगल हमेशा इसकी प्रोटेक्शन करेगा। आपके धन, वैभव, चरित्र, शरीर के सारी चीजों की रक्षा आपके मंगल करेगा। हनुमान रूप में है तो भी क्योंकि यह रक्षा तो करने वाला ही देवता है।
says: Mars protects Venus always: it guards your wealth, grandeur, character and body, and even in the Hanuman form it is a protector deity by nature.
ambiguity: He states Mars protects Venus matters, a protection role rather than ownership.
classical_check: Partly agrees; Mars as guardian deity (Hanuman, Kartikeya) is a tradition link.

hindi: और दो नंबर राशि और सात नंबर का मंगल जो होता है पंप कर देता है बहुत जबरदस्त तरीके से।
says: Mars placed in sign number 2 (Taurus) or sign number 7 (Libra), the two Venus signs, pumps Venus in a very powerful way.
cells_derived_method: Mars in a Venus sign sits in the house given by lagna; Taurus gives 2nd, 7th, 12th etc., so the pumped area follows house topic. Mars in an enemy-like sign of Venus feeds Venus matters (money, partners, luxury) with heat.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio) strongly pumps partnerships and spouse matters.
Derived: Mars in Libra in the 4th (lagna Cancer) pumps comfort, vehicles and home luxury.
Derived: Mars in Taurus in the 11th (lagna Cancer) pumps income and gains.

ambiguity: Numbers could be house numbers but his series uses sign numbers; the caption ties it to Venus signs 2 and 7.
classical_check: Partly agrees; Mars in a Venus sign is mixed in classical texts, not usually called very strong.

hindi: लेकिन यहां पर वरुण देवता अगर आपकी कुंडली में बढ़िया बैठे हैं तो आपको ह्यूमंगस जो जो लोग यह बड़े-बड़े पैलेस में बैठे हैं, बड़े-बड़े हवाई जहाज ले बैठे हैं, कहीं आते जाते हैं चार्टर्ड फ्लाइट्स लेते हैं वो सब नेप्च्यून की कृपा है।
says: If Neptune is well placed, the person gets humongous results; those living in big palaces and using large aircraft and chartered flights owe it to Neptune's grace.
cells_derived_method: Palaces show in the 4th, flights in the 3rd and 9th; Neptune strong in those houses points to these results.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 4th in Pisces (lagna Sagittarius) gives a palace-like home.
Derived: Neptune in the 9th in Sagittarius (lagna Aries) gives frequent chartered or long travel.

classical_check: Outside the classical set.

hindi: शुक्र और नेप्च्यून का कहीं ना कहीं कंजक्शन दृष्टि होती है।
says: Venus and Neptune always have some link somewhere, a conjunction or an aspect, in such rich charts.
cells_derived_method: Link can be same house or Neptune aspect on Venus; where it falls sets the area enriched.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus and Neptune together in Libra in the 2nd (lagna Virgo) enrich wealth and family.
Derived: Venus exalted and Neptune in Pisces in the 10th (lagna Gemini) enrich career status.

ambiguity: Somewhere may mean any sign; no fixed rule given.
classical_check: Outside the classical set.

hindi: वरुण की सबसे बड़ी खासियत है। हजार दृष्टि का देवता है।
says: Neptune's biggest feature is that it is the god of a thousand aspects; its aspect reaches widely.
ambiguity: A thousand eyes probably means it aspects widely; no specific houses given.
classical_check: Outside the classical set; Varuna as lord of the waters is a mythic link.

hindi: यह जब देखता है तो शुक्र को पकड़ के कहता है हां मैं देता हूं। जहां शुक्र कुंडली में बैठा है वहां यह लाजवाब कर देगा।
says: When Neptune looks at Venus it grabs it and says I will give; wherever Venus sits in the chart, Neptune makes that house matter outstanding.
cells_derived_method: Results go to the house where Venus sits; sign and house decide the topic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in the 5th in Taurus (lagna Capricorn) with Neptune aspect gives outstanding creativity or children.
Derived: Venus in the 8th in Libra (lagna Pisces) with Neptune aspect gives outstanding inheritance or hidden gains.

ambiguity: Neptune's aspect houses not defined here.
classical_check: Outside the classical set.

hindi: अगर शुक्र खराब बैठा है तो खराबी को लाजवाब कर देगा। यानी आप एक बार क्या पकड़ेगा थाने में आपको जब तक 14 दिन की रिमांड नहीं मिलेगी तब तक छोड़ेगा नहीं।
says: If Venus is badly placed, Neptune's aspect makes the damage outstanding too, amplifying it; once it grips you it will not let go, like police custody that is not released before a 14-day remand.
cells_derived_method: Amplified damage appears where Venus is afflicted (debilitated in Virgo, in dusthana, with malefics) and the house shows what is hit.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus debilitated in the 6th in Virgo (lagna Aries) with Neptune aspect amplifies enemy and legal trouble.
Derived: Venus in the 12th in Aries (lagna Taurus) with Neptune aspect amplifies loss and confinement.

ambiguity: The remand talk is a joke illustrating gripping; not a prediction of arrest.
classical_check: Outside the classical set.

hindi: लेकिन लग्जरी के साथ देता है। यानी थाने में जेल में भी बंद है तो भी बंदे को पार्टी देगा। ऐसे लोग होते हैं जो वहां पर भी जाके भी पैसे देके काम करा रहे हैं।
says: But Neptune gives it with luxury: even in jail the person gets parties and buys comforts and favours; troubles come, but cushioned by money.
ambiguity: Not an astrological claim of imprisonment; an illustration.
classical_check: Outside the classical set.

hindi: तो इसकी बहुत बड़ा ग्रैंड ह्यूमंगस हो जाता है।
says: Summarising: the result becomes very big and grand, humongous, with Neptune involved.
classical_check: Outside the classical set.

gist: Audience remark about Venus talk and Charles, Gautam replies yes.
He says the chart of Charles Sobhraj would have to be checked, he does not know it, they are just chatting.
Even in jail he is the emperor; he set fire there too.
Sentence about adjustment and compromise being a form of something is cut off and garbled in the caption.
Says it is not nice to talk about the person present, tells the audience to drop it.
Says this is the state of every husband.

hindi: बृहस्पति गुरु है। ये हमेशा चाहता है शुक्र स्वस्थ प्रसन्न रहे। लिवर हमेशा चाहता है हार्ट प्रसन्न रहे।
says: Jupiter, the guru, always wants Venus healthy and happy, just as the liver (Jupiter's organ) always wants the heart (Venus) happy.
cells_derived_method: A supportive Jupiter link to Venus (aspect, conjunction, sign link) helps Venus matters in the house where Venus sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter with Venus in Pisces in the 7th (lagna Virgo) cushions and blesses marriage; Venus exalted, Jupiter in own sign.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign in Sagittarius aspecting Venus in the 2nd (lagna Scorpio) supports family wealth.

ambiguity: Liver-Jupiter and heart-Venus are his body mapping; classical texts give Jupiter liver and Venus genitals or kidneys, so this is his own scheme. No medical claim is taken.
classical_check: Differs; classical Venus body parts are not the heart. Jupiter liver or fat is classical.

gist: Emphasis line telling the audience to tie this firmly in a knot, i.e. remember it.

hindi: स्त्री क्यों नाराज रहती है सारे टाइम? खुश भी होती है लेकिन पति के सामने क्यों?
says: He sets up the question of why a wife seems upset all the time even though she is also happy, specifically in front of her husband; a Venus attention-seeking behaviour pattern.
ambiguity: This is a question leading to the next explanation, not a rule by itself.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Skit: the husband also acts when coming home from office, puts the phone away, says bye, acts tired.
Skit continues: tired, soul drained, grabbing bag, saying he does not know what happened today.

hindi: शुक्र से ध्यान खींच रहा है वो।
says: The husband's acting tired and dramatic is a way of pulling Venus attention to himself; both partners draw on each other's attention through Venus.
ambiguity: Part of the skit; low confidence it is a rule.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Skit: wife says she asked one thing and he keeps going on, so he is putting on a show to draw her attention.
Skit: a smarter wife sits at the dining table beforehand with water set out when he arrives.
Skit continues: TV off, radio off, earphones out, Bluetooth off, phone restarted and set aside.
She sits with water ready and says she knew he would come, she sees him from the sides and behind.

hindi: शुक्र बहुत चालाक है।
says: Venus is very clever; it reads the other person's moves and works around them.
ambiguity: Cleverness is tied to the skit; not a classical karaka.
classical_check: Silent; classical Venus is arts and pleasure, though shrewdness in relations is common folk reading.

gist: Jokes about why a couple stays together 24 hours, asks them to spend some of it elsewhere.
He says that was a joke.

hindi: लेकिन शुक्र इसलिए ताकि उसको ध्यान ऊर्जा मिलती रहे। सब ऊर्जा लेते हैं।
says: The purpose of Venus behaviour is to keep receiving attention as energy; everyone takes energy, and Venus takes it as attention.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए आप ये लेके चलेंगे कि आप परेशान है। दैट मींस स्त्री या पुरुष हर समय दिखाता है। ये परेशान है।
says: So to keep attention coming, a woman or a man will show all the time that they are troubled; showing distress is a Venus tactic to collect attention.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यदि पहले ही खुश हो ही गए तो दूसरा तो ध्यान देना ही बंद कर देगा। कौन सी पत्नी है जो पति को कहे मैं तुम्हारे साथ संतुष्ट हूं?
says: If one shows contentment at once, the other stops giving attention; no wife says she is satisfied with her husband, because satisfaction would end his attention to her.
ambiguity: A generalisation about wives, not an astrological rule.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वो उसकी तरफ ध्यान ही नहीं देगा। वो सारे टाइम यही दिखाएगी जरूर। मैं परेशान हूं। वो फिर ध्यान देगा। तो उसका ध्यान तो खींचेगा ही ना।
says: Since a satisfied wife would lose his notice, she will keep showing she is upset, he then pays attention, and so she draws his attention; the point is the Venus mechanism of attention by displayed distress.
ambiguity: Repeats the previous idea; kept as its own row because it closes the argument.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लिवर सर्वप्रथम हार्ट को सेट करता है। हार्ट सर्वप्रथम ब्रेन को सेट करता है।
says: In his body chain, the liver (Jupiter) first sets the heart (Venus), and the heart in turn first sets the brain; so Jupiter feeds Venus, and Venus feeds the mind.
ambiguity: Brain planet not named in this sentence (likely Mercury or Moon); this is a body mapping, not a medical claim.
classical_check: Differs from classical Venus body parts; his own scheme.

hindi: हार्ट सारे के सारे ब्लड की सप्लाई सब जगह से तोड़ता के लिवर को भी छोड़ देता है वो। वो कहता है पहले
says: The heart sends blood supply everywhere and even leaves the liver to take its turn after others; the sentence is cut off at the batch end with he says first, so the intended order is not complete.
ambiguity: Sentence is truncated; the claim about priority between heart and liver cannot be completed.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ब्रेन को जिंदा रखो। इसलिए बेड पे पड़े हुए आदमी को ऑर्गन फेलियर हो रहे हैं।
says: Continuing his heart-brain body chain: the heart works to keep the brain alive, so in a bedridden person the other organs fail one after another while the brain is served first; recorded as his body mapping, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: Medical content; no medical claim is adopted. The caption begins mid-thought from the previous batch.
classical_check: Silent; not a classical Jyotish statement.

hindi: हार्ट चल के चल रही है तो ब्रेन को जिंदा रखता है वो। उसका काम है ब्रेन को जिंदा रखूंगा।
says: The heart, as long as it keeps running, keeps the brain alive; that is its priority job, so Venus (heart) serves the brain-planet first before other organs.
ambiguity: He does not name the brain planet here.
classical_check: Differs from classical body parts for Venus; this is his own heart-Venus scheme.

hindi: भाई मेरे लिए सबसे इंपॉर्टेंट तो ब्रेन है। अगर यह जिंदा नहीं रही तो मैं चलूंगा कैसे? इसलिए बॉडी खराब नीचे से होती है धीरे-धीरे।
says: Speaking as the heart, he says the brain matters most to it, since without a living brain it cannot function, and therefore the body degrades slowly from the bottom upward.
ambiguity: Body mapping, no planet named in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बृहस्पति एक बूढ़ा ग्रह है।
says: Jupiter is an old planet, an elder; its nature carries age and maturity.
classical_check: Differs in detail; Parashara gives Jupiter a middle-aged or elder look, Mercury is young, Venus is youthful.

hindi: शुक्र सुंदर युवती मानी जाती है। बहुत सौंदर्य है इसमें।
says: Venus is regarded as a beautiful young woman and is full of beauty; youthfulness and charm are Venus significations.
classical_check: Agrees; Venus is the karaka of beauty and youth.

hindi: इसलिए नीचे का हिस्सा शरीर का पहले बूढ़ा होता है। ऊपर का हिस्सा बाद में बूढ़ा होता है हमारे शरीर के अंदर। यह सारी की सारी ऊर्जाओं का खेल है।
says: Following the Jupiter-old and Venus-young contrast, he says the lower half of the body ages first and the upper half later, and calls it all a play of energies.
ambiguity: The logic linking this to the planets is loose; no chart rule results from it. Not a medical claim.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह बड़ी सुंदर कथा है के शुक्राचार्य दैत्य गुरु
says: Introducing a story: Shukracharya, the Venus figure, is the guru of the daityas (demons), so Venus is the preceptor of the asuras while Jupiter is preceptor of the devas.
ambiguity: Jupiter as deva guru is implied, not said in this sentence.
classical_check: Agrees with tradition; Shukra is guru of the asuras.

gist: He distinguishes Bali (Mahabali) from Vali; Bali is such a great asura he was made Indra for one manvantara.

hindi: असुर राज बलि लेकिन ये पाताल का है तो यह थाई एरिया के ऊपर है।
says: King Bali rules Patala, the netherworld, and in his body mapping that realm sits above the thigh area; underworld lies in the region of the lower body.
ambiguity: Caption garbled: could be above or around the thigh. Link of Patala to a body region is his own mapping.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Later, in the Vamana avatar, King Bali performs Shukracharya's rite which will make him lord of the three worlds.
Vishnu learns of the plan and says this is a big problem and wonders what to do.

hindi: शुक्र के तो सारे टाइम एक ही लफड़े हैं। साला मैं ही छाऊंगा।
says: Venus always has the same trouble: its nature is to say I alone will dominate; Venus wants to be the one who shines and takes the whole stage.
classical_check: Silent; classical Venus is vain and pleasure-loving which is close.

hindi: अरे मैं कहता हूं तू भी रह ले यार पर क्या करूं? ये मानता नहीं है। शैतान बुद्धि है। ये कहता है मैं ही मैं छा जाऊं।
says: Speaking as Vishnu, he says Venus will not accept sharing space with others: it has a devilish, scheming mind and insists on being the only one to cover everything.
ambiguity: Devilish intelligence refers to Venus as the asura guru; not meant literally.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जैसे एक बड़ी साधारण सी बात। कई लोगों का स्वभाव होता है। पार्टी में जाएंगे, कहीं पब्लिक में जाएंगे, लोगों में जाएंगे, हम ही छाएंगे बाकी मर जाओ। ये प्योर शुक्र की पावर है।
says: A simple example: some people at a party or in public want to be the only one who shines and the rest to fade; he calls this pure Venus power in a person's nature.
cells_derived_method: Venus in the 1st, 3rd, 5th or 11th house, or in Leo or Libra, would show this trait more openly; in the 12th it is hidden.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in the 1st in Libra (own sign, lagna Libra) gives a person who naturally takes the centre of the room.
Derived: Venus in the 11th in Gemini (lagna Leo) shows a social crowd-pleaser who wants admirers.

classical_check: Agrees in part; Venus on the lagna gives a charming, attention-drawing personality.

hindi: ऐसे ही हर स्त्री अपने आप में सुंदर बनने के लिए इसी चीज में लगी हुई है कि मुझे कौन देख रहा है। 100 स्त्रियां पार्टी में गई। सब सुंदर बन के गई और सब यही देख रही है। मुझे कौन देख रहा है।
says: Likewise, every woman who dresses up is occupied with who is looking at her; of a hundred women at a party all dressed well, each is checking who is watching her.
ambiguity: A broad claim about women, treated as a Venus-attention illustration, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कोई भी दूसरी को देख ही नहीं रहा है। सब यही चाहते हैं सब मुझे देखें। तो यह स्थिति शुक्र की है।
says: Nobody is looking at anyone else because everyone wants everyone to look at her; that craving to be seen is the Venus condition.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: At Vamana avatar time Vishnu came in dwarf form; the Jupiter-like Brahmin asks King Bali for a gift (caption garbled after this).
Bali was a great daitya king and very generous; Shukra said wait, he is about to do a rite.
Horse sacrifice will give lordship of three worlds; the guru will ask what fee he wants and ask for the three worlds.
Vamana came in as a Brahmin; Shukracharya stops Bali from giving him anything.
Vamana asks for only three steps of land to build a small house; Shukracharya warns it is Vishnu in disguise.
Bali says he has given his word; Vishnu gives him the Indra title and makes him immortal because he kept his word.

hindi: जो वाणी का आदर रखता है उसका बुध बहुत पावरफुल होता है और उसे वरद हस्तता मिलती है।
says: Whoever honours his spoken word has a very powerful Mercury and receives the power of boons, so keeping your word strengthens Mercury and gives the ability to bless.
cells_derived_method: Mercury governs speech; the 2nd house (speech) and 3rd (communication) show where word-keeping matters; Mercury in own or exalted sign would give the boon power its full form.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury exalted in Virgo in the 2nd (lagna Leo) gives speech that becomes true and carries blessings.
Derived: Mercury in own sign in Gemini in the 3rd (lagna Aries) gives reliable communication and promise-keeping.

ambiguity: This sentence begins at the end of the story chunk and continues into the next one.
classical_check: Partly agrees; Mercury is lord of speech but boon-giving through promise-keeping is not a classical rule.

hindi: राहु इतना पावरफुल होता है। राहु सरस्वती माता है।
says: Rahu becomes very powerful in such a person; he equates Rahu with Mother Saraswati, so Rahu carries the goddess of speech and learning.
ambiguity: Classical Saraswati is Mercury's or Jupiter's deity; Rahu equal to Saraswati is his own scheme.
classical_check: Differs; Saraswati is classically tied to Mercury or Jupiter, and Rahu's deity is Durga.

hindi: यानी आप में श्राप और वरदान देने की शक्ति है। राहु की कृपा से होती है। सरस्वती की कृपा से।
says: The power to curse and to bless comes from Rahu's grace, i.e. from Saraswati's grace; a person with strong Rahu has words that take effect.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in the 2nd (speech), 3rd or 5th gives words that strike; Rahu in a Mercury sign Gemini or Virgo links to his Rahu-Virgo idea.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Gemini in the 2nd (lagna Taurus) gives speech that curses or blesses with force.
Derived: Rahu in Virgo in the 5th (lagna Taurus) gives mantra power in speech.

classical_check: Partly agrees; Rahu in the 2nd is said to give sharp speech.

gist: Says that point stays pending and returns to the story.
Vamana asks for water in the cupped hand to seal the vow; Shukracharya enters the water pot as a bee.
From inside the pot Shukracharya starts watching with one eye.

hindi: राइट आई राइट आई हमारा सूर्य होता है। लेफ्ट चंद्रमा होता है।
says: The right eye is the Sun and the left eye is the Moon in his body mapping.
cells_derived_method: Eye houses in the chart are the 2nd and 12th; Sun's sign and house show the right eye side, Moon's the left.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted in the 2nd in Aries (lagna Pisces) shows a strong right-eye significator.
Derived: Sun debilitated in the 12th in Libra (lagna Scorpio) would be read as a strain on the right-eye side, a tradition reading only.

ambiguity: Right-Sun, left-Moon is the standard mapping; houses for eyes are my additions.
classical_check: Agrees; Sun as right eye and Moon as left eye is classical.

hindi: राइट आई का डिफेक्ट है। मेन सून सूर्य का लफड़ा है। लेकिन उस डिफेक्ट के अंदर जितना भी आंख का डिफेक्ट है वो शुक्र ही है।
says: A right-eye defect is mainly a Sun problem, but within eye defects in general, as per him, all of it ultimately belongs to Venus; recorded as his claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Watch Sun and Venus afflictions together with the 2nd and 12th houses; Venus debilitated in Virgo or with Saturn or Rahu in those houses marks the tradition reading of eye trouble.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 12th (lagna Libra) would be read as an eye-weakness indicator, only as tradition claim.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 2nd (lagna Virgo) with Venus afflicted would be read as an eye indicator.

ambiguity: Whether Sun is the cause and Venus the overall, or both, is unclear. Medical content is not endorsed.
classical_check: Partly agrees; classical texts give eyes to Sun, Moon and Venus.

hindi: आंखों की जो भी प्रॉब्लम पंगा हो रहा है वो सारा शुक्र है। ए टू जेड।
says: Whatever eye problem or trouble is occurring, he says it is all Venus, from A to Z; he generalises Venus as the eye planet.
ambiguity: Sweeping statement. Not a medical claim; tradition mapping only.
classical_check: Partly agrees; Venus has eyes in classical karakas but not all eye problems.

hindi: अब उन्होंने जब एक आंख से देखा पानी ना जाए रोक दिया तो कुशा हरे रंग की घास को कुशा बोलते हैं और जब वो सूख चुकी है लकड़ी बन गई कलर चेंज हो गया तो वो सूर्य रूपी बुध हो गया
says: Kusha is green grass, so green is Mercury; once dry it becomes wood and changes colour, which he calls Sun-like Mercury; a symbolic reading of kusha as Mercury turning solar.
ambiguity: The caption is garbled in the middle and merges story and symbolism; reading is tentative.
classical_check: Partly agrees; green and plants are Mercury in tradition, but dried-kusha-as-Sun is his own.

gist: Vamana used a kusha stick to clear the pot's spout and blinded Shukracharya's eye.

hindi: तो कहा जाता है एक आंख से शुक्र देख नहीं सकते तो सारे काने व्यक्ति
says: It is said that Venus cannot see with one eye, so all one-eyed people fall under Venus; Venus is the planet of the one-eyed.
ambiguity: The sentence runs into the next chunk; the one-eyed link to Venus comes from the myth.
classical_check: Agrees; Shukra is called Kana (one-eyed) in the story, though not a classical rule.

hindi: अंधे व्यक्ति की सेवा हमारी जितनी भी होती है वो शनि के लिए होती है
says: Service of blind people, all of it, counts as an offering to Saturn, not Venus.
classical_check: Partly agrees; service to the disabled and poor is a classical Saturn remedy.

hindi: आप आंख मूंद के ब्लाइंडली अगर आपकी लाइफ में कुछ सूझ ही नहीं रहा रास्ता। किसी अंधे को भोजन खिलाओ रास्ते खुल जाएंगे।
says: If you cannot see any way out in life, feed a blind person and the paths will open; Saturn-based remedy for a blocked, directionless period.
ambiguity: No chart condition for when to do this.
classical_check: Partly agrees; feeding the blind is a lesser-known Saturn remedy.

hindi: शनि खुद बता देगा।
says: Saturn himself will show you the way after this service; guidance is received once the service is done.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Garbled sentence about someone with no grandeur in life and a not doing first something to people; cannot recover the meaning.

hindi: ऐसे लोग होते हैं जो फिल्मों में एक आंख पे पट्टी लगा के कहते हैं हीरोइन का अपहरण मैं करूंगा। उनकी सेवा करें।
says: He points to one-eyed people (like film villains with an eye patch) and advises serving them; serving the one-eyed is the remedy for Venus, in contrast to serving the blind for Saturn.
ambiguity: Context is poor because the previous sentence is unreadable; reading as a Venus remedy is inferred.
classical_check: Silent; not a classical remedy.

hindi: ये शुक्र एक आंख से देख नहीं सकते तो अपना मुंह नहीं दिखाते। तो ये वो देवता है जो चेहरा नहीं दिखाते।
says: Since Venus cannot see with one eye, he does not show his face; Venus is the deity who hides his face.
classical_check: Silent; mythic.

hindi: इसलिए ऐसी स्थिति में शुक्र के द्वारा लीड किए जाने वाले जितने भी धर्म इत्यादि हैं, वह कहते हैं कि फेस नहीं दिखाना। इसलिए फेस नहीं दिखाया जाता।
says: Therefore religions or traditions that are led by Venus say not to show the face, and the face is not shown; he links face-covering customs to the Venus one-eyed story.
ambiguity: A sensitive claim about religious customs; no religion is named and it is recorded only as his statement.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says there is a very long and very controversial story behind this.

hindi: एनी हाउ यह वामन अवतार की वजह से ऐसी स्थिति है।
says: Anyhow, he says Venus's one-eyed condition arises because of the Vamana incarnation; the Vamana episode is the origin of the Venus defect.
classical_check: Silent; mythic origin.

hindi: और वामन के ठीक पश्चात ऊपर के चक्र पे हम आते हैं, तो मनुष्य का उत्थान हो रहा है। बौना मानव बना, फिर उसके बाद गुस्से वाला मानव बना। परशुराम फिर उसके बाद मर्यादा वाला राम बना
says: Immediately after Vamana the avatars go up the chakra ladder and man rises: a dwarf human first, then an angry human (Parashurama), then Rama of propriety.
ambiguity: Sentence begins at the end of chunk 5 and continues in chunk 6; chakra link is stated loosely.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard avatar sequence; the chakra and human evolution link is his own.

hindi: फिर अटकेलियां करने वाला कृष्ण फिर बुद्धि के द्वारा जीवन चलाने वाला बुद्ध फिर कल्कि यह कॉन्शियसनेस के तल पर है
says: Then comes playful Krishna, then Buddha who runs life through intellect, then Kalki; all of these are at the level of consciousness, not matter.
classical_check: Silent on mapping to astrology; sequence agrees with the dashavatara list.

hindi: उसके साथ यह शुक्र की कलाकारी है कि यह भविष्य देख सकता है जितने लोग भविष्य के बारे में अंदाजा लगाते हैं सब शुक्र है
says: Venus has the skill of seeing the future; everyone who guesses about the future is operating through Venus, so prediction is a Venus function.
ambiguity: Not found in classical karakas for Venus; Shukracharya's Sanjivani and foresight are mythic.
classical_check: Partly agrees; Shukracharya is a seer in myth, but classical Jyotish gives prediction to Jupiter and Mercury.

hindi: लेकिन भविष्य देख के भी उसको बदल नहीं सकता और बृहस्पति कृपा देकर के आपके भविष्य को बदलने की कृपा रखता है।
says: Venus can see the future but cannot change it, while Jupiter, by giving grace, has the power to change your future.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with Jupiter as karaka of grace.

hindi: कृपा किससे मिलेगी? वह वरुण से मिलती है।
says: Where does that grace come from? He answers that it comes from Varuna (Neptune); Neptune is the source of the grace that Jupiter passes on.
classical_check: Outside the classical set.

hindi: जिस प्रकार हर ग्रह की एक्सिस्टेंस है, उसी प्रकार हर ग्रह के ऊपर ही एक देवी या देवता बनाया गया है।
says: Just as every planet exists, every planet has a goddess or god placed above it; each planet has a presiding deity.
classical_check: Agrees; planetary adhidevata are part of tradition.

hindi: विष्णु के लिए बृहस्पति, चंद्रमा के लिए शिव जी आ गए।
says: Jupiter is paired with Vishnu and the Moon with Shiva as the deities of those planets.
ambiguity: The caption order is Vishnu for Jupiter, so I read Jupiter's deity as Vishnu.
classical_check: Agrees in part; Jupiter-Vishnu is common, Moon is classically Parvati or Varuna, Shiva is also given.

hindi: शनि अपने आप में देवता है जिनकी एंटिटी बनाई गई है।
says: Saturn is himself a deity whose own entity is established; he needs no other god above him.
classical_check: Differs in detail; classical texts give Saturn's adhidevata as Yama or Brahma, but Shani is also worshipped directly.

hindi: राहु के पास सरस्वती है।
says: Rahu has Saraswati as his deity, the deity assignment list for the planets.
classical_check: Differs; classical adhidevata for Rahu is Durga or Sarpa.

hindi: बुध के पास दुर्गा माता की परिकल्पना। ऐसे
says: Mercury is conceived with Mother Durga as its deity; the list is cut off after this.
ambiguity: Sentence is cut at the batch end.
classical_check: Differs; Mercury is classically Vishnu or Durga, Durga for Mercury is accepted in some traditions.

hindi: शुक्र की जो परिकल्पना है वह लक्ष्मी की है।
says: The deity imagined for Venus is Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and beauty; Venus carries the Lakshmi principle.
classical_check: Agrees in part; Lakshmi is a common Venus deity, though some lists give Indrani or Parvati.

hindi: शुक्र ग्रह जब उच्च का होता है यानी सर्वश्रेष्ठ जैसे घर में जाते हैं आप वर्मा जी के घर गए शर्मा जी के खन्ना जी के तो जैसे अलग-अलग देवता अलग-अलग के घर यानी राशि में जाते हैं।
says: When Venus is exalted it is in its best state; he compares planets to guests who visit the homes of different families, so each planet visiting a different sign is like a deity going to a different house.
cells_derived_method: Sign as host: the reception a planet gets depends on the sign it enters; the house it falls in then sets the life area.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus exalted in the 7th in Pisces gives the warmest reception to marriage and partnerships.
Derived: Venus debilitated in the 6th in Virgo is the cold reception, with friction in service and rivals.

ambiguity: The exalted sign is not named in this sentence; it follows in the next ones.
classical_check: Agrees; planets in friendly, own and exalted signs are treated as welcome guests in classical texts too.

hindi: शुक्र एक नंबर राशि दो नंबर तीन चार पांच ऐसे जाता है तो अलग-अलग स्वागत मिलता है। कहीं डंडे मिलते हैं कहीं प्यार मिलता है। कहीं अच्छा कहीं बुरा
says: As Venus moves through sign 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and the rest, it gets a different welcome in each: sticks in some, love in others, good in one and bad in another.
cells_derived_method: Venus strength by sign: warm in Taurus, Libra and Pisces, cold in Virgo, mixed in Aries, Scorpio and Leo; the house sets the life area where the welcome or the stick applies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra) gets a rough, sticks welcome in a Mars sign, so partnership is hot and conflicted.
Derived: Venus in own sign Taurus in the 2nd (lagna Aries) gets a loving welcome and gives family wealth ease.
Derived: Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 5th (lagna Taurus) gets a cold welcome with trouble in romance and creativity.

ambiguity: Numbers are sign numbers; he is only counting through the signs.
classical_check: Agrees; classical dignity gives Venus a varying reception by sign.

hindi: तो शुक्र को सबसे ज्यादा प्यार यानी कि अरे आप मेरे घर आए आओ बैठो बैठो सबसे ऊंचा आसन केतु केतु का घर है 12 नंबर राशि मीन राशि
says: Venus gets the most love, the highest seat, in the house of Ketu, which is sign number 12, Pisces; Venus is exalted in Pisces, and he gives Ketu as the lord of Pisces.
cells_derived_method: Venus exalted in Pisces in each house: 1st gives charm and beauty, 2nd rich family and speech, 4th comfort, 7th ideal spouse, 10th glamorous career, 11th big gains, 12th spiritual or bed pleasures.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus exalted in the 7th in Pisces (lagna Virgo) gives an idealised, loving spouse and partnership luxury.
Derived: Venus exalted in the 10th in Pisces (lagna Gemini) gives a glamorous, artistic or hospitality-linked career.
Derived: Venus exalted in the 12th in Pisces (lagna Aries) gives luxury abroad, bed pleasures and generous spending.

ambiguity: Pisces lordship by Ketu is his scheme (Jupiter or Ketu).
classical_check: Agrees on exaltation in Pisces; Ketu as lord of Pisces differs from classical Jupiter.

hindi: शुक्र वीनस प्लनेट के ऊपर सल्फ्यूरिक एसिड के बादल है इतने बादल हैं कि उन बादलों ने सूर्य की लाइट को ट्रैप कर दिया है।
says: Over the planet Venus lie clouds of sulfuric acid, so thick that they have trapped the Sun's light; he uses the planet's physical clouds as an image for Venus's character.
ambiguity: Physical claim; Venus' clouds mostly reflect sunlight, they do not just trap it. Used only as a symbol.
classical_check: Silent; modern astronomy only.

hindi: ऐसा नहीं है कि वो प्लनेट गर्म है। यह केतु की वजह से है।
says: The planet is not hot by nature; the trapping cloud layer is due to Ketu, so he assigns the cloud cover over Venus to Ketu.
ambiguity: Physical statement is inaccurate: Venus is hot because of its dense carbon-dioxide atmosphere. Recorded as his claim.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो शुक्र के पास इतनी सूर्य जैसी ताकत सूर्य जैसी गर्मी सूर्य जैसी चमक के वह रात को भी चमकता है
says: Venus has Sun-like strength, heat and brilliance, so much that it shines even at night; he treats Venus as holding a solar-like light.
ambiguity: Sentence runs into the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: चंद्रमा के बाद अकेला सबसे ज्यादा चमकदार प्लेनेट यह कैसे है? क्योंकि बादल है सल्फ्यूरिक एसिड।
says: After the Moon, Venus is the brightest planet alone, and he explains this by the sulfuric acid clouds.
ambiguity: Brightness is real; the reason given is astronomy, not Jyotish (the clouds reflect most light).
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हमारे यहां जो बादल हैं, वह बड़े धीमे और हल्के पतले बादल हैं धरती के ऊपर। ये बादल सूर्य की लाइट्स को रिफ्लेक्ट करते हैं और अंदर ट्रैप नहीं कर पाते। 10% लाइट को रिफ्लेक्ट करते हैं।
says: Earth's clouds are slow, light and thin and they mostly reflect sunlight and cannot trap it inside, reflecting about 10 percent; this is a contrast to Venus.
ambiguity: The 10 percent figure is not accurate (Earth reflects around 30 percent); no astrological content.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सूर्य पर की लाइट धरती पर आ रही है। सूर्य को ग्रहण भी लगता है केतु से पर बहुत पार्शियल। तो वो बहुत थोड़ा सा आता है।
says: Sunlight comes to Earth; the Sun also gets eclipsed by Ketu but only very partially, so Ketu blocks only a little of the Sun's light.
ambiguity: It is unclear whether he means Ketu eclipsing the Sun is a minor effect or a lighter one than Rahu's.
classical_check: Differs; classical texts treat both Rahu and Ketu as eclipse causers.

hindi: 10% लाइट रिफ्लेक्ट होती है। 90% धरती पर आ जाती है। फिर जो आती है 90% वो भी बाहर निकल लेती है। तो 25% ही ग्रीन हाउस इफेक्ट है धरती के ऊपर। 20 से 25% यानी जो लाइट आई वो ट्रैप हो गई। बाहर नहीं गई।
says: He gives numbers: about 10 percent of light is reflected, 90 percent reaches Earth, most of that goes back out, so only about 20 to 25 percent is trapped by the greenhouse effect on Earth.
ambiguity: Figures are approximate and the physics is loose; not astrology.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मरकरी पर ऐसा नहीं है। बुध पर नहीं है। शुक्र पर ऐसा है। बादलों की वजह से।
says: This light-trapping does not happen on Mercury, but it does on Venus because of its clouds, so Venus is distinguished from the planet nearer the Sun.
ambiguity: Planetary physics only.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ये सारे बादल है केतु।
says: All of those clouds are Ketu; he assigns the cloud principle, i.e. wrapping, covering and trapping, to Ketu.
ambiguity: Clouds as Ketu is his own symbolism.
classical_check: Silent; Ketu is classically linked to smoke, mist and flags.

hindi: तो जब केतु के घर में शुक्र आता है तो केतु कहता है आपका ही घर है। आज तो मतलब अहोभाग्य हो गए हमारे। इतना तो हमें अपना घर आज तक अच्छा नहीं लगा जितना आपके आने से लगा।
says: When Venus enters Ketu's house the host says it is your own home and we are honoured; the house never felt so good as with Venus there, so Pisces welcomes Venus warmly.
cells_derived_method: Venus in Pisces in a house raises that house's topics; the sign hosts the house topic with extra warmth.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in Pisces in the 4th (lagna Sagittarius) lifts home comfort, vehicles and mother-related happiness.
Derived: Venus in Pisces in the 11th (lagna Taurus) lifts gains and friends circle.

classical_check: Agrees that Venus is exalted in Pisces.

hindi: तो जब मामा जी घर आते हैं तो बड़ा मजा आता है। हम नानी
says: An analogy begins: when the maternal uncle comes home it is great fun; he starts to compare going to a nani's house, a guest visiting gives more joy than one's own home.
ambiguity: Sentence continues in the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जी के घर जाते हैं तो हमें बड़ा अच्छा लगता है। दादी के घर तो बहुत पार्टी है। अपने घर में नहीं है।
says: Going to your maternal grandmother's house feels great and your paternal grandmother's house is a party, which your own home is not; being a guest elsewhere is more fun than being at home.
ambiguity: Analogy for exaltation.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसे शुक्र अपने घर से भी ज्यादा लाजवाब फल देता है। जब केतु के यहां जाता है। तो केतु के घर मीन राशि में सर्वोत्तम फल।
says: So Venus gives better results in Pisces, Ketu's house, than even in its own signs Taurus and Libra; Pisces gives its best results.
cells_derived_method: Compare Venus in Pisces with Venus in Taurus or Libra in the same house: Pisces yields the larger result, own signs a good but smaller result.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus exalted in the 7th in Pisces (lagna Virgo) is stronger for marriage than Venus in Libra in the 7th (lagna Virgo).
Derived: Venus in own sign Taurus in the 2nd (lagna Aries) is good for wealth, but less than Venus in Pisces in the 2nd (lagna Aries).

classical_check: Agrees; exaltation outranks own sign in classical dignity.

hindi: अब इस देवता की कल्पना की गई। शुक्र कौन है? स्त्री ग्रह। मीन राशि में पूर्वा भाद्रपद, उत्तरा भाद्रपद और रेवती तीन नक्षत्र हैं।
says: Now the deity is imagined: Venus is the feminine planet, and Pisces holds Purva Bhadrapada, Uttara Bhadrapada and Revati as its three nakshatras; he starts using nakshatras to derive the image of Lakshmi.
ambiguity: Strictly Purva Bhadrapada is only partly in Pisces; he corrects this in the next sentences.
classical_check: Differs slightly; Pisces holds the last quarter of Purva Bhadrapada, all of Uttara Bhadrapada and Revati.

hindi: तीन नक्षत्रों में पूर्वा भाद्रपद तीन चरण जो पहले तीन चरण है नक्षत्रों की बात बहुत अलग है। ये पहले तीन चरण कुंभ राशि में है। वो यमराज के पास है। प्लूटो के पास। चौथा चरण मात्र ये है।
says: Of the three nakshatras, the first three padas of Purva Bhadrapada lie in Aquarius, which belongs to Yamaraj (Pluto) in his scheme, and only the fourth pada is in Pisces.
ambiguity: Aquarius with Pluto is his scheme; classical Saturn is the lord.
classical_check: Agrees on the padas (3 in Aquarius, 1 in Pisces); Pluto as lord is his scheme.

hindi: इसकी सिंह योनि है। योनि मीनंस शक्ल क्या है? इसके ऊपर सिंह योनि है। तो इसका इंपैक्ट बहुत लो लिटिल मिनि ना होना बराबर हो गया।
says: Purva Bhadrapada has the lion as its yoni (animal symbol); since only one pada falls in Pisces, its impact on Pisces is very low, almost nil.
ambiguity: Impact weighting by pada share is his own reasoning.
classical_check: Agrees that the yoni of Purva Bhadrapada is the lion; the weighting is his.

hindi: अब यह पूरा नहीं है। पूरा नक्षत्र है उत्तरा भाद्रपद और रेवती। उत्तरा भाद्रपद की योनि है गाय।
says: Only Uttara Bhadrapada and Revati lie entirely in Pisces, and the yoni of Uttara Bhadrapada is the cow.
classical_check: Agrees; the yoni of Uttara Bhadrapada is the cow.

hindi: तो यानी कि शुक्र गाय समान कल्पना कर दी गई है कि जीवो में कौन है? गाय।
says: Venus is therefore imagined as cow-like: among living beings the cow stands for Venus in this nakshatra, the nurturing giver.
classical_check: Silent; cow as Venus symbol is common in Vedic tradition.

hindi: अब शुक्र जो है रेवती नक्षत्र में भी सर्वोत्तम है। गज।
says: Venus is also at its best in Revati nakshatra, whose animal is the elephant (gaj).
cells_derived_method: Revati is the last 3 degrees 20 minutes of Pisces; Venus there in a house keeps its exalted strength at the sign end, so that house topic ends on a high.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in Revati in the 9th in Pisces (lagna Cancer) gives fortune and blessing through teachers.
Derived: Venus in Revati in the 5th in Pisces (lagna Scorpio) gives refined creativity and good fortune with children.

ambiguity: The elephant name continues into the next chunk.
classical_check: Agrees that the Revati yoni is the elephant; Venus-in-Revati-is-best is not a classical statement but Venus is exalted at 27 degrees of Pisces.

hindi: इसकी योनि है गज। हाथी। गज। गज है। गज कौन है? राहु। लेकिन यह सर्वोत्तम फल कहां दे रहा है? केतु की राशि में।
says: Revati's yoni is gaj, the elephant, and he says the elephant is Rahu; yet Venus gives this best result in Ketu's sign, with Rahu's elephant in Ketu's house.
ambiguity: Elephant as Rahu is his own association (Airavata links to Indra and Rahu).
classical_check: Silent on the Rahu-elephant link; Revati yoni elephant is classical.

hindi: राहु और केतु आमने सामने पड़े होते हैं।
says: Rahu and Ketu always sit opposite one another, 180 degrees apart; the elephant and the Ketu house are counterparts.
classical_check: Agrees; Rahu and Ketu are always 180 degrees apart.

hindi: अब यह रेवती नक्षत्र जो है यह 12 नंबर राशि मीन जो केतु के पास है बृहस्पति के साथ सम्मिलित हमारे कहां पर हमारे स्वाधिष्ठान चक्र पे
says: Revati, in sign 12 Pisces, belongs to Ketu together with Jupiter, and in the body it is placed at the svadhisthana (sacral) chakra.
ambiguity: Chakra mapping of Pisces is his scheme.
classical_check: Differs; Jupiter is the sole classical lord of Pisces and chakra links are not part of Parashara.

hindi: स्वाधिष्ठान चक्र में ही स्पर्म बनता है एग बनता है यानी नया जन्म इसी से होता है।
says: Sperm and egg are made at the sacral chakra, so new birth comes from here; the svadhisthana is the creation centre.
ambiguity: Body mapping statement, no medical claim adopted.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शरीर की एक्सटेंशन सारी केतु है। लिंग और योनि का मिलन ही केतु के कारण से होता है। जिसके कारण संतति प्राप्त होती है।
says: All extension of the body is Ketu, and the union of the male and female organs happens because of Ketu, through which offspring is obtained.
cells_derived_method: Ketu in or aspecting the 5th or 8th would be read as acting on union and progeny; the sign sets its manner.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in the 5th in Pisces (lagna Scorpio) ties the progeny matter to Ketu's union role.
Derived: Ketu in the 8th in Scorpio (lagna Aries) would put the union and sexual matters under Ketu.

classical_check: Differs; classically Venus rules union and Jupiter children, Ketu is detachment.

hindi: बृहस्पति एक्टिवेट होता है। स्पर्म और एग शुक्र के सम्मेलन से नया जीव की उत्पत्ति होती है।
says: Jupiter is activated by this, and the meeting of sperm and egg, which are Venus substances, gives rise to a new being; Jupiter is the child karaka triggered once Venus unites.
classical_check: Agrees in part; Jupiter is putra karaka, Venus is karaka of semen and reproduction.

gist: Says this is a small khichdi, a compact summary.

hindi: रेवती नक्षत्र का जो योनि है वो गज है। तो हाथी खड़े होने चाहिए। कीट होता है, वनचर होता है, द्विपद होता है। ऐसे ऐसे अलग-अलग किस्म के चलने वाले जीव की कल्पना की गई है।
says: Since Revati's yoni is the elephant, elephants should stand in the deity image; yoni classes include insects, forest animals and two-footed beings, imagined as different kinds of moving creatures.
ambiguity: The meaning of yoni classes is only mentioned, not set out.
classical_check: Agrees; yoni animals are assigned per nakshatra.

hindi: तो यह जलचर है। यह राशि जलचर है। 12 नंबर मीन राशि जलचर है।
says: Pisces is an aquatic sign, a water-dweller; sign 12 is in the jalachara (water-creature) class.
ambiguity: The sentence crosses the chunk boundary.
classical_check: Agrees; Pisces is a watery, fruitful sign and counted among the jalachara signs.

hindi: तो यहां जल होना बहुत ज्यादा जरूरी है। ऐसी कल्पना की जा रही है कि भाई पानी होना चाहिए।
says: So water is essential in this image; the deity of Venus's best result is imagined with water around her.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: उसके बाद साथ एक स्त्री होनी चाहिए। अब जो स्त्री होगी वो शुक्र है। सबसे बढ़िया फल दे रहा है।
says: Next there must be a woman, who is Venus, in the image, since Venus gives its best results here.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो यार गहना, सोना, चांदी, जम के वैभव, सौंदर्य लाजवाब होना चाहिए। एक ऐसा देवता बनाया जाए। फिर दो हाथी खड़े कर दो यार इसके आसपास में फूल है, सौंदर्य है। यह सब सुंदरता की चीजें हैं सारी की सारी।
says: The image must have jewellery, gold, silver, grandeur and beauty, so a goddess is made with two elephants beside her and flowers around, all things of beauty, which becomes the Lakshmi icon.
ambiguity: Iconography reasoning, not a rule on charts.
classical_check: Silent; Gaja Lakshmi iconography is traditional.

hindi: उसके पश्चात इसकी नाड़ी क्या है? नाड़ी होती है हमारी एक इदा पिंगला और एक सुषुमना। यानी कि मैनिफेस्टेशन का इलाका बनाओ।
says: Next he asks about the nadi of this nakshatra: our channels are ida, pingala and sushumna, and he calls this the area of manifestation.
ambiguity: Nadi here is the yogic channel, not the matching nadi kuta of kundali milan.
classical_check: Partly agrees; the nakshatra nadi classification of Adi, Madhya and Antya exists and he maps it to yogic nadis.

hindi: तो स्वाधिष्ठान चक्र के ऊपर केतु बैठा हुआ है।
says: Ketu sits over the svadhisthana chakra; the sacral chakra is Ketu's seat.
classical_check: Silent; chakra mapping is not classical Jyotish.

hindi: हमारे आदि, अंत और मध्य तीनों नाड़ी यानी इदा, पिंगला और सुषुम्ना। यानी आप नो सोचोगे तो नो वाली चीज भी मैनिफेस्ट हो जाएगी। यस सोचोगे यस वाली भी
says: Revati carries all three nadis, the beginning, end and middle, i.e. ida, pingala and sushumna; so if you think no, the no manifests, and if you think yes, the yes manifests.
ambiguity: Whether this assigns one nadi to each nakshatra or all three to Revati is unclear.
classical_check: Differs; classical nakshatra nadi is a single value per nakshatra, not all three.

hindi: और मध्यमा नाड़ी यानी जो बीच में चलती है सुषुमना परमात्मा पर छोड़ दोगे तो वो आपके लिए वैसे ही बेस्ट क्रिएट कर देगा यानी कैसा बेबी क्रिएट करना है अच्छा क्रिएट करना है नालायक क्रिएट करना है नॉनसेंस क्रिएट करना है बेवकूफ क्रिएट करना है साइंटिस्ट क्रिएट करना है यह
says: If you leave the middle channel sushumna to the Divine, it will create the best for you; the sentence then lists the kinds of baby that can be created: good, useless, nonsense, foolish or a scientist.
ambiguity: Sentence runs into the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: स्वाधिष्ठान चक्र के पास है अब ये शुक्र यदि अच्छा है संभोग के समय तो आपका संतान सुंदर हो पुष्ट हो शरीर से सुंदर हो
says: This lies near the sacral chakra; if Venus is good at the time of union, the child will be beautiful and well-built in body.
cells_derived_method: Venus condition at conception time would be read by sign and house in the muhurta chart; Venus exalted in Pisces or in own signs counts as good.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus exalted in the 5th in Pisces (lagna Scorpio) at conception gives a beautiful, healthy child.
Derived: Venus debilitated in the 5th in Virgo (lagna Taurus) at conception would be read as a weaker, less attractive result.

ambiguity: Conception time is an event chart, not the natal chart; this is a tradition claim about garbhadhan timing.
classical_check: Partly agrees; classical texts discuss garbhadhan muhurta with Venus and Jupiter strong.

hindi: अट्रैक्ट चीजें अट्रैक्ट करने वाली यानी संसार में वैभवशाली राजाओं के समान चीजें इकट्ठी करने वाली ज्ञान के साथ और लोगों को बांटने वाली यह फिलथ्रोपिस्ट बनाता है यानी जबरदस्त दानी महात्मा बना देगा।
says: Such a child will be attractive, gathering wealth like kings and sharing it with knowledge; Venus makes a philanthropist, a very generous giver and saintly person.
classical_check: Silent; generosity is classically linked to a strong Jupiter and 2nd or 11th lord.

hindi: यह ऐसी स्थिति में उसप खूब धन होना चाहिए।
says: In such a situation the person must also have plenty of money; the generous Venus result needs abundant wealth to sustain it.
ambiguity: Caption word upasa is garbled; I read it as for him.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो तीनों नाड़ियां यहां काम कर रही हैं। यानी कि इतना पावरफुल है यहां पर शुक्र के हर चीज की मैनिफेस्टेशन दे सकता है आपको।
says: All three nadis work here, so Venus in this spot is powerful enough to manifest anything for you.
cells_derived_method: Venus in Pisces in a house manifests that house's topics, so it grants what the house signifies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus exalted in the 2nd in Pisces (lagna Aquarius) manifests money and family harmony.
Derived: Venus exalted in the 10th in Pisces (lagna Gemini) manifests career status in glamour fields.

classical_check: Partly agrees; exalted Venus is classically strong but not described as manifesting anything.

hindi: जो बेस्ट फल देने वाली स्थिति है वो एक स्त्री की कल्पना कर दी गई। महालक्ष्मी का मूरत बना दी गई
says: The condition that gives the best result was imagined as a woman, and that became the idol of Mahalakshmi; Lakshmi is the personified form of exalted Venus.
classical_check: Silent; interpretive.

hindi: और लक्ष्मी को गणपति के साथ बिठा दिया गया कि भाई ज्ञान भी डाल दो भाई केतु को भी स्थापित कर दो यहां गणपति भी साथ होंगे तो बुद्धि भी तो चलेगी
says: Lakshmi was seated with Ganapati so that knowledge and Ketu are installed beside wealth; Ganapati is Ketu, and with him present, intelligence also works.
classical_check: Agrees in part; Ganesha is classically tied to Ketu.

hindi: उल्लू पे सवार होके आएगी पागल तो नहीं हो जाओगे लक्ष्मी संभलेगी भी तो
says: Lakshmi arrives riding an owl, so wealth without Ganapati's wisdom could drive you mad, and he says the intelligence is also needed to hold the wealth when it comes; the sentence is cut off at the batch end.
ambiguity: Truncated at the batch end.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: गणपति साथ चाहिए और हाथी डाल दिया बहुत बड़ा सिर होता है गज का मस्तक
says: Ganapati is needed beside Lakshmi and the elephant is added because the elephant has a very big head; the gaj head, a large skull of intellect, belongs with the Venus-Ketu image.
ambiguity: The link between the big elephant head and Rahu as intellect is made later; here it is only iconography.
classical_check: Silent; Ganesha as Ketu is a tradition link.

hindi: बेस्ट फल शुक्र उच्च राशि केतु के अंदर देता है बृहस्पति के नौ नंबर में नहीं देता अच्छा होता है
says: Venus gives its best result in its exalted sign, inside Ketu's house Pisces, while in Jupiter's sign number 9 (Sagittarius) it does not give the best though the result is still good.
cells_derived_method: Compare Venus in Pisces and Sagittarius in the same house: Pisces gives the peak, Sagittarius a decent but lesser result with knowledge-flavoured pleasure.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus exalted in the 7th in Pisces (lagna Virgo) gives peak marital happiness.
Derived: Venus in the 7th in Sagittarius (lagna Gemini) gives a good but more principled, less indulgent partnership.

ambiguity: Ninth sign is Sagittarius if numbers are signs; if houses, it would be the 9th.
classical_check: Agrees that Venus is exalted in Pisces; Sagittarius is neutral for Venus classically.

hindi: बृहस्पति कहता है आप भी देवता हो मैं भी देव गुरु हूं एक प्रकार से तो स्वागत है।
says: Jupiter greets Venus with you are a god too and I am the guru of the gods, so welcome; he explains a mild, courteous reception of Venus in Jupiter's house.
ambiguity: Sagittarius is implied from the previous sentence; Pisces is also Jupiter's sign in classical lists.
classical_check: Differs; classical texts treat Jupiter and Venus as enemies, not as welcoming hosts.

hindi: लेकिन 12 नंबर में केतु है जो एक प्रकार दैत्य है। केतु क्या है? शरीर।
says: But sign 12 has Ketu, who is in a way a daitya; he defines Ketu as the body, the physical form.
classical_check: Differs; classically Ketu is moksha and detachment, not the body.

hindi: एक सर्प होता है जो सांप है उसका जो मुंडी है वो राहु है और पीछे का जो बॉडी है धड़ वो केतु है।
says: In the snake image, the head of the serpent is Rahu and the trunk or body at the back is Ketu.
classical_check: Agrees; the head-tail split of Rahu and Ketu is traditional.

hindi: तो ये जो शरीर है ना ये ये शुक्र है। इसके अंदर की जो अग्नि है वो मंगल है। जो तेज है वो सूर्य है। इस प्रकार चलता है।
says: The body itself is Venus; the fire inside it is Mars and the radiance or glow is the Sun, so the body is built as Venus form, Mars heat and Sun lustre.
ambiguity: Venus as the body is his scheme; Ketu was also called the body in the previous sentence.
classical_check: Differs; classically the Sun is the soul and Moon the mind, with Venus ruling the reproductive system.

hindi: ये शुक्र है। तो आपके जीवन में भोग कितना है? भोगते कहां से हैं हम? शरीर से भोगते हैं ना?
says: Venus rules enjoyment: the amount of bhoga in your life is a Venus matter, and we enjoy through the body.
classical_check: Agrees; Venus is karaka of sensual enjoyment.

hindi: यानी शरीर के जितने भी ऐश अय्याशी, मौज, मस्ती, संभोग इत्यादि के क्रियाएं हैं, वह शुक्र के पास है।
says: All bodily luxuries, indulgences, fun, revelry and sexual acts belong to Venus.
classical_check: Agrees; Venus is the karaka of sex and pleasure.

hindi: इसीलिए ज्ञान की बात में यदि हम संभोग भोग की बातें करेंगे तो ओषो की तरह बदनाम होते हैं हमेशा कि बृहस्पति और शुक्र में पंगा है
says: If knowledge talk is mixed with talk of sex and enjoyment, one gets a bad name as Osho did, because Jupiter and Venus are in conflict; he links the Jupiter-Venus enmity to mixing wisdom and sensuality.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter and Venus are mutual enemies in Parashara's scheme.

gist: Comment that of Osho's lakh sayings only one was grabbed and he was called the sex guru, though his story was different.
Other people will say something else, that is their faith, and there are different views.

hindi: यह शुक्र की प्रसन्नता के लिए आपको देवी की पूजा करनी है।
says: To please Venus, worship the Goddess; devi worship is the remedy for a Venus that needs to be satisfied.
classical_check: Agrees; devi and Lakshmi worship is the classical Venus remedy.

hindi: धन का अपमान नहीं करना। पैसा फेंक के मत दो क्योंकि फेंके हुए पैसे अमिताभ बच्चन आज भी नहीं उठाता।
says: Do not insult wealth: never hand over money by throwing it, since even Amitabh Bachchan's character would not pick up thrown money; respect for money keeps Lakshmi happy.

gist: Fumbles the film character's name (Vijay, Jai, Veeru) and laughs.

hindi: हाथी का हमेशा मान करो।
says: Always honour the elephant; respect for elephants, as Rahu's animal and Lakshmi's attendant, is a tradition remedy.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हाथी यह सफेद है राहु यह भी बड़ी कृपा देने लग जाता है।
says: The white elephant is Rahu in its good form; when Rahu is white, it begins to give great grace.
ambiguity: A white elephant must be read as a pure or well-placed Rahu; the chart condition is not given.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जो ब्राउन ग्रे कलर का ब्राउन नहीं ग्रे कलर का हाथी है वो आपका अगर नुकसानदायक बैठ जाता है।

ambiguity: What grey Rahu means in a chart is not defined.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: एरावत की सवारी कौन करता है? इंद्र करता है। जोर ग्रे हाथी के पास चला जाता है। शुक्र नीच का हो जाता है। अकेला यानी वैभव नहीं।
says: Airavata is ridden by Indra; when Venus goes to the grey elephant it becomes debilitated, alone, and there is no grandeur; the grey-elephant Rahu sign (his Virgo) ruins Venus's wealth.
cells_derived_method: Venus debilitated in Virgo shows loss of grandeur in the house topic: 2nd money, 4th comfort, 7th partner, 10th status.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus debilitated in the 2nd in Virgo (lagna Leo) gives thin family wealth and plain living.
Derived: Venus debilitated in the 7th in Virgo (lagna Pisces) gives a critical, unromantic spouse.

ambiguity: Garbled caption; Virgo as the grey elephant sign is inferred from the next sentences where Venus is debilitated in Rahu's house.
classical_check: Agrees that Venus is debilitated in Virgo; Rahu's rulership of Virgo is his scheme.

hindi: यानी कि आप ज्ञान ज्ञानी व्यक्ति जो बुद्धि है उसको आप भटका नहीं सकते जब तक कि आपका राहु नष्ट ना हुआ हो। राहु स्ट्रांग होता है तो बात बढ़िया है।
says: A knowledgeable person's intellect (Rahu) cannot be led astray as long as his Rahu is not destroyed; when Rahu is strong, things are fine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Virgo in the 5th (lagna Taurus) gives a sharp intellect that resists temptation.
Derived: Rahu in the 8th in Pisces (lagna Leo) weakens the intellect's hold, more open to being led astray.

classical_check: Differs; classical Rahu gives obsession and illusion, not a protector of intellect.

hindi: केतु आते ही कहता है आइए आइए भोगिए।

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सारे भोगी लोगों को क्या होता है? खोपड़ी तो बंद होती है उनकी। कब करेंगे आप ऐशयाशी? शरीर से भोग
says: Habitual pleasure-seekers have a shut skull, no thinking head; he asks when will they indulge, with the body enjoying; the body without Rahu head just consumes.

classical_check: Silent.

says: Without a working head the pleasure-seeker goes mad anywhere, drinks anyone's free liquor and takes anyone's money; he asks whether there is no sense, showing Ketu body without Rahu intellect.

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जब अकल है राहु तो मुंडी अकेली है। अब राहु के घर शुक्र जाता है। उसके पास ये है ही नहीं।
says: Intellect is Rahu, and Rahu is the head alone; when Venus goes to Rahu's house it finds no body there, so Venus in Rahu's sign has no means of enjoyment.
cells_derived_method: Venus in Rahu's sign has the intellect but not the body; house topics become mental and critical rather than sensual.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in the 7th in Virgo (lagna Pisces) gives a partnership of analysis and restraint rather than bodily pleasure.
Derived: Venus in the 12th in Virgo (lagna Libra) gives little bed pleasure, with expenses on health and service.

ambiguity: Rahu's sign is Virgo (or Aquarius classically) in his scheme; he does not name the sign here, only the next sentence says Venus is debilitated at Rahu's house.
classical_check: Differs; Rahu has no lordship in Parashara, though some give Virgo or Aquarius.

hindi: तो क्या होता है अल्टीमेटली शांत कुछ नहीं कर सकता भाई जो तुम्हारी मर्जी करो अगर राहु बढ़िया है तो शुक्र को बैंड बजा देता है उसको कहता है
says: Ultimately Venus can do nothing there: if Rahu is strong, he flatters and then browbeats Venus, saying do as you like; strong Rahu keeps Venus subdued and idle.

hindi: इसलिए शुक्र नीच का होता है राहु के यहां और उच्च का होता है केतु के यहां
says: This is why Venus is debilitated in Rahu's house and exalted in Ketu's house; the exaltation and debilitation of Venus is explained by Ketu body versus Rahu head.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus debilitated in the 4th in Virgo (lagna Gemini) gives austere home and few comforts.

hindi: अब शुक्र को समझो क्या है शुक्र मजे का देवता है अय्याशी का देवता है अब नीच का हो गया उसकी अय्याशी रुक गई
says: Venus is the god of fun and indulgence; once it is debilitated, its indulgence stops, so a debilitated Venus reduces pleasure-seeking.

hindi: आप ध्यान से पकड़ेंगे उलट फल है ये अगर उच्च का शुक्र है तो ऐश हो रही है बड़े मजेदार मस्ती मस्ती से उच्च का लाजवाब खूब पार्टी खूब ऐश मौज मस्ती
says: Note the reverse effect: when Venus is exalted, enjoyment flows, fun, parties and revelry in plenty, so exalted Venus actually increases indulgence.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus exalted in the 5th in Pisces (lagna Scorpio) gives plentiful romance, parties and entertainment.
Derived: Venus exalted in the 11th in Pisces (lagna Taurus) gives a lively social circle and enjoyment through friends.

classical_check: Agrees that exalted Venus increases pleasures.

hindi: अय्याशी चली जाती है इंद्र के पास अब यह ऐश अय्याशी पर ग्रहण लग गया तो नीच का शुक्र इज नॉट बैड
says: The indulgence goes to Indra (Uranus) and the pleasure gets eclipsed, so a debilitated Venus is not bad; the caption is jumbled and the Indra link may belong to the debilitation case.

hindi: उच्च का शुक्र अच्छा है नीच का शुक्र बुरा नहीं है बुरा तो वो उच्च का भी है क्योंकि वो क्या करेगा एक पुरुष या एक स्त्री से संतुष्ट नहीं होगा वो भटकेगा 10 को पालेगा
says: Exalted Venus is good and debilitated Venus is not bad; even the exalted one has a flaw, since it will not be satisfied with one man or woman and will wander and keep ten.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus exalted in the 7th in Pisces (lagna Virgo) shows dissatisfaction with a single partner as a risk.
Derived: Venus debilitated in the 7th in Virgo (lagna Pisces) shows the same urge but held back by caution.

ambiguity: A sweeping claim; it is a statement of tendency, not a prediction for anyone.
classical_check: Differs; classical texts treat debilitated Venus as harmful to marriage.

hindi: लेकिन नीच का शुक्र भी यही करेगा लेकिन कंट्रोलोल्ड एनवायरमेंट में क्यों क्योंकि उसके पास शरीर नहीं है।
says: Debilitated Venus will do the same but in a controlled environment, because it has no body there; the Rahu-sign Venus lacks the Ketu body so action stays limited.

says: People who only flirt in words and do nothing have a very powerful Rahu and cannot be shaken by temptations; talk without action is Rahu head without Ketu body.
classical_check: Silent.

says: Those who go astray without even flirting, who carry only dirty thoughts of sex and consumption in the mind, are the other type described here.

classical_check: Silent.

says: If the intellect holds the reins, Venus stays at your feet; therefore Lakshmi comes even to a person with debilitated Venus, at his feet, though she will not go to his head.

hindi: जिस दिन वो यह चीज के कारण सत्यानाश करना शुरू करता है। जिसको हम साक्षी भाव कहते हैं। साक्षी भाव खो गया।

hindi: शुक्र आपका कुछ बिगाड़ ना पाएगा क्योंकि सूर्य को शुक्र अपना शत्रु मानता है।
